namespace MyRestaurant.Domain.Orders;

public sealed record NarratedPriceAdjustment(
    decimal PreviousUnitPriceAmount,
    decimal NewUnitPriceAmount,
    string Reason,
    OrderActorRole ActorRole,
    DateTimeOffset OccurredAt);

public sealed record NarratedOrderLine(
    Guid GuestOrderIdentifier,
    Guid OrderLineIdentifier,
    Guid MenuItemIdentifier,
    int Quantity,
    decimal OriginalUnitPriceAmount,
    decimal CurrentUnitPriceAmount,
    string? CustomizationNote,
    bool IsFulfilled,
    DateTimeOffset AddedAt,
    Guid AddedByOrderEventIdentifier,
    OrderEventType AddedByEventType,
    Guid AddedByActorPersonIdentifier,
    OrderActorRole AddedByActorRole,
    bool IsRemoved,
    Guid? RemovedByActorPersonIdentifier,
    OrderActorRole? RemovedByActorRole,
    string? RemovalReason,
    DateTimeOffset? RemovedAt,
    IReadOnlyList<NarratedPriceAdjustment> PriceAdjustments)
{
    public decimal LineTotalAmount => IsRemoved ? 0m : Quantity * CurrentUnitPriceAmount;

    public bool IsPriceAdjusted => PriceAdjustments.Count > 0;

    public bool IsPending => !IsRemoved && !IsFulfilled;

    public bool GuestMayRemove(Guid personIdentifier)
        => IsPending
        && AddedByEventType == OrderEventType.GuestSubmission
        && AddedByActorPersonIdentifier == personIdentifier;
}

public static class OrderNarrative
{
    public static IReadOnlyList<NarratedOrderLine> FromEvents(IReadOnlyList<OrderEvent> events)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(events);

        Dictionary<Guid, Accumulator> lines = new();

        foreach (OrderEvent orderEvent in events.OrderBy(orderEvent => orderEvent.SequenceNumber))
        {
            foreach (OrderOperation operation in orderEvent.Operations)
            {
                switch (operation)
                {
                    case LineAddedOperation added when !lines.ContainsKey(added.OrderLineIdentifier):
                        lines[added.OrderLineIdentifier] = new Accumulator
                        {
                            GuestOrderIdentifier = orderEvent.GuestOrderIdentifier,
                            OrderLineIdentifier = added.OrderLineIdentifier,
                            MenuItemIdentifier = added.MenuItemIdentifier,
                            Quantity = added.Quantity,
                            OriginalUnitPriceAmount = added.UnitPriceAmount,
                            CurrentUnitPriceAmount = added.UnitPriceAmount,
                            CustomizationNote = added.CustomizationNote,
                            AddedAt = orderEvent.OccurredAt,
                            AddedByOrderEventIdentifier = orderEvent.OrderEventIdentifier,
                            AddedByEventType = orderEvent.EventType,
                            AddedByActorPersonIdentifier = orderEvent.ActorPersonIdentifier,
                            AddedByActorRole = orderEvent.ActorRole,
                        };
                        break;

                    case LineRemovedOperation removed
                        when lines.TryGetValue(removed.OrderLineIdentifier, out Accumulator? removedLine):
                        removedLine.IsRemoved = true;
                        removedLine.RemovedByActorPersonIdentifier = orderEvent.ActorPersonIdentifier;
                        removedLine.RemovedByActorRole = orderEvent.ActorRole;
                        removedLine.RemovalReason = removed.Reason;
                        removedLine.RemovedAt = orderEvent.OccurredAt;
                        break;

                    case LinePriceAdjustedOperation adjusted
                        when lines.TryGetValue(adjusted.OrderLineIdentifier, out Accumulator? adjustedLine):
                        adjustedLine.PriceAdjustments.Add(new NarratedPriceAdjustment(
                            adjustedLine.CurrentUnitPriceAmount,
                            adjusted.NewUnitPriceAmount,
                            adjusted.Reason,
                            orderEvent.ActorRole,
                            orderEvent.OccurredAt));
                        adjustedLine.CurrentUnitPriceAmount = adjusted.NewUnitPriceAmount;
                        break;

                    case LineFulfilledOperation fulfilled
                        when lines.TryGetValue(fulfilled.OrderLineIdentifier, out Accumulator? fulfilledLine):
                        fulfilledLine.IsFulfilled = true;
                        break;

                    case LineFulfillmentRevertedOperation reverted
                        when lines.TryGetValue(reverted.OrderLineIdentifier, out Accumulator? revertedLine):
                        revertedLine.IsFulfilled = false;
                        break;
                }
            }
        }

        return lines.Values
            .Select(line => line.ToNarratedLine())
            .OrderBy(line => line.AddedAt)
            .ThenBy(line => line.OrderLineIdentifier)
            .ToArray();
    }

    private sealed class Accumulator
    {
        public required Guid GuestOrderIdentifier { get; init; }
        public required Guid OrderLineIdentifier { get; init; }
        public required Guid MenuItemIdentifier { get; init; }
        public required int Quantity { get; init; }
        public required decimal OriginalUnitPriceAmount { get; init; }
        public required string? CustomizationNote { get; init; }
        public required DateTimeOffset AddedAt { get; init; }
        public required Guid AddedByOrderEventIdentifier { get; init; }
        public required OrderEventType AddedByEventType { get; init; }
        public required Guid AddedByActorPersonIdentifier { get; init; }
        public required OrderActorRole AddedByActorRole { get; init; }

        public required decimal CurrentUnitPriceAmount { get; set; }
        public bool IsFulfilled { get; set; }
        public bool IsRemoved { get; set; }
        public Guid? RemovedByActorPersonIdentifier { get; set; }
        public OrderActorRole? RemovedByActorRole { get; set; }
        public string? RemovalReason { get; set; }
        public DateTimeOffset? RemovedAt { get; set; }
        public List<NarratedPriceAdjustment> PriceAdjustments { get; } = [];

        public NarratedOrderLine ToNarratedLine() => new(
            GuestOrderIdentifier,
            OrderLineIdentifier,
            MenuItemIdentifier,
            Quantity,
            OriginalUnitPriceAmount,
            CurrentUnitPriceAmount,
            CustomizationNote,
            IsFulfilled,
            AddedAt,
            AddedByOrderEventIdentifier,
            AddedByEventType,
            AddedByActorPersonIdentifier,
            AddedByActorRole,
            IsRemoved,
            RemovedByActorPersonIdentifier,
            RemovedByActorRole,
            RemovalReason,
            RemovedAt,
            PriceAdjustments.ToArray());
    }
}

namespace MyRestaurant.Domain.Orders;

public sealed record ProjectedOrderLine(
    Guid GuestOrderIdentifier,
    Guid OrderLineIdentifier,
    Guid MenuItemIdentifier,
    int Quantity,
    decimal CurrentUnitPriceAmount,
    string? CustomizationNote,
    bool IsFulfilled,
    DateTimeOffset AddedAt,
    Guid AddedByOrderEventIdentifier)
{
    public decimal LineTotalAmount => Quantity * CurrentUnitPriceAmount;
}

public sealed record ProjectedOrder(
    Guid GuestOrderIdentifier,
    IReadOnlyList<ProjectedOrderLine> Lines,
    int PendingLineCount,
    int FulfilledLineCount,
    decimal CurrentTotalAmount,
    DateTimeOffset? FirstSubmittedAt,
    DateTimeOffset? LastEventAt);

public static class OrderProjection
{
    public static ProjectedOrder FromEvents(IReadOnlyList<OrderEvent> events)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(events);

        IReadOnlyDictionary<Guid, LineState> states = BuildLineStates(events);

        List<ProjectedOrderLine> lines = states.Values
            .Where(state => !state.IsRemoved)
            .Select(state => new ProjectedOrderLine(
                state.GuestOrderIdentifier,
                state.OrderLineIdentifier,
                state.MenuItemIdentifier,
                state.Quantity,
                state.CurrentUnitPriceAmount,
                state.CustomizationNote,
                state.IsFulfilled,
                state.AddedAt,
                state.AddedByOrderEventIdentifier))
            .OrderBy(line => line.AddedAt)
            .ThenBy(line => line.OrderLineIdentifier)
            .ToList();

        Guid guestOrderIdentifier = events.Count > 0 ? events[0].GuestOrderIdentifier : Guid.Empty;

        DateTimeOffset? firstSubmittedAt = events
            .Where(orderEvent => orderEvent.EventType == OrderEventType.GuestSubmission)
            .Select(orderEvent => (DateTimeOffset?)orderEvent.OccurredAt)
            .DefaultIfEmpty(null)
            .Min();

        DateTimeOffset? lastEventAt = events
            .Select(orderEvent => (DateTimeOffset?)orderEvent.OccurredAt)
            .DefaultIfEmpty(null)
            .Max();

        return new ProjectedOrder(
            guestOrderIdentifier,
            lines,
            PendingLineCount: lines.Count(line => !line.IsFulfilled),
            FulfilledLineCount: lines.Count(line => line.IsFulfilled),
            CurrentTotalAmount: lines.Sum(line => line.LineTotalAmount),
            firstSubmittedAt,
            lastEventAt);
    }

    internal static IReadOnlyDictionary<Guid, LineState> BuildLineStates(IReadOnlyList<OrderEvent> events)
    {
        Dictionary<Guid, LineState> states = [];

        foreach (OrderEvent orderEvent in events.OrderBy(orderEvent => orderEvent.SequenceNumber))
        {
            foreach (OrderOperation operation in orderEvent.Operations)
            {
                switch (operation)
                {
                    case LineAddedOperation added when !states.ContainsKey(added.OrderLineIdentifier):
                        states[added.OrderLineIdentifier] = new LineState
                        {
                            OrderLineIdentifier = added.OrderLineIdentifier,
                            GuestOrderIdentifier = orderEvent.GuestOrderIdentifier,
                            MenuItemIdentifier = added.MenuItemIdentifier,
                            Quantity = added.Quantity,
                            OriginalUnitPriceAmount = added.UnitPriceAmount,
                            CurrentUnitPriceAmount = added.UnitPriceAmount,
                            CustomizationNote = added.CustomizationNote,
                            AddedAt = orderEvent.OccurredAt,
                            AddedByOrderEventIdentifier = orderEvent.OrderEventIdentifier,
                            AddedByEventType = orderEvent.EventType,
                            AddedByActorPersonIdentifier = orderEvent.ActorPersonIdentifier,
                            AddedByActorRole = orderEvent.ActorRole,
                        };
                        break;

                    case LineRemovedOperation removed when states.TryGetValue(removed.OrderLineIdentifier, out LineState? removedState):
                        removedState.IsRemoved = true;
                        break;

                    case LinePriceAdjustedOperation adjusted when states.TryGetValue(adjusted.OrderLineIdentifier, out LineState? adjustedState):
                        adjustedState.CurrentUnitPriceAmount = adjusted.NewUnitPriceAmount;
                        break;

                    case LineFulfilledOperation fulfilled when states.TryGetValue(fulfilled.OrderLineIdentifier, out LineState? fulfilledState):
                        fulfilledState.IsFulfilled = true;
                        break;

                    case LineFulfillmentRevertedOperation reverted when states.TryGetValue(reverted.OrderLineIdentifier, out LineState? revertedState):
                        revertedState.IsFulfilled = false;
                        break;
                }
            }
        }

        return states;
    }
}

internal sealed class LineState
{
    public required Guid OrderLineIdentifier { get; init; }
    public required Guid GuestOrderIdentifier { get; init; }
    public required Guid MenuItemIdentifier { get; init; }
    public required int Quantity { get; init; }
    public required decimal OriginalUnitPriceAmount { get; init; }
    public required string? CustomizationNote { get; init; }
    public required DateTimeOffset AddedAt { get; init; }
    public required Guid AddedByOrderEventIdentifier { get; init; }
    public required OrderEventType AddedByEventType { get; init; }
    public required Guid AddedByActorPersonIdentifier { get; init; }
    public required OrderActorRole AddedByActorRole { get; init; }

    public decimal CurrentUnitPriceAmount { get; set; }
    public bool IsFulfilled { get; set; }
    public bool IsRemoved { get; set; }
}

using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;

namespace MyRestaurant.Domain.Security;

public static class Argon2PhcString
{
    public const int Version = 19;
    private const string AlgorithmLabel = "argon2id";

    public static string Encode(Argon2Parameters parameters)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(parameters);
        return $"${AlgorithmLabel}$v={Version}$m={parameters.MemoryKibibytes},t={parameters.Iterations},p={parameters.Parallelism}$" +
               $"{StandardBase64NoPadding(parameters.Salt)}${StandardBase64NoPadding(parameters.Tag)}";
    }

    public static Argon2Parameters Parse(string phcString)
    {
        if (!TryParse(phcString, out Argon2Parameters? parameters))
        {
            throw new FormatException("The value is not a well-formed argon2id PHC string.");
        }

        return parameters;
    }

    public static bool TryParse(string phcString, [NotNullWhen(true)] out Argon2Parameters? parameters)
    {
        parameters = null;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(phcString))
        {
            return false;
        }

        string[] segments = phcString.Split('$');
        if (segments.Length != 6 || segments[0].Length != 0)
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (!string.Equals(segments[1], AlgorithmLabel, StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (!TryParseTaggedInteger(segments[2], "v", out int version) || version != Version)
        {
            return false;
        }

        string[] costs = segments[3].Split(',');
        if (costs.Length != 3
            || !TryParseTaggedInteger(costs[0], "m", out int memoryKibibytes)
            || !TryParseTaggedInteger(costs[1], "t", out int iterations)
            || !TryParseTaggedInteger(costs[2], "p", out int parallelism))
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (!TryDecodeStandardBase64NoPadding(segments[4], out byte[] salt)
            || !TryDecodeStandardBase64NoPadding(segments[5], out byte[] tag))
        {
            return false;
        }

        parameters = new Argon2Parameters(memoryKibibytes, iterations, parallelism, salt, tag);
        return true;
    }

    public static bool NeedsRehash(Argon2Parameters stored, int configuredMemoryKibibytes, int configuredIterations, int configuredParallelism)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(stored);
        return stored.MemoryKibibytes != configuredMemoryKibibytes
            || stored.Iterations != configuredIterations
            || stored.Parallelism != configuredParallelism;
    }

    private static bool TryParseTaggedInteger(string segment, string expectedTag, out int value)
    {
        value = 0;
        int equals = segment.IndexOf('=');
        if (equals != expectedTag.Length
            || !segment.AsSpan(0, equals).SequenceEqual(expectedTag))
        {
            return false;
        }

        return int.TryParse(segment.AsSpan(equals + 1), out value);
    }

    private static string StandardBase64NoPadding(byte[] bytes) => Convert.ToBase64String(bytes).TrimEnd('=');

    private static bool TryDecodeStandardBase64NoPadding(string text, out byte[] bytes)
    {
        bytes = [];
        string padded = (text.Length % 4) switch
        {
            2 => text + "==",
            3 => text + "=",
            1 => text,
            _ => text,
        };

        try
        {
            bytes = Convert.FromBase64String(padded);
            return true;
        }
        catch (FormatException)
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
}

public sealed record Argon2Parameters(int MemoryKibibytes, int Iterations, int Parallelism, byte[] Salt, byte[] Tag);

  Size:                  2.2 KiB (2287 bytes)
  SHA-256:               b86cee4eb5158ca78b3c1aa27a5fb45c516f22cda20edf760c39dd817bb0b0a8

--- CONTENT ---
namespace MyRestaurant.Domain.Security;

public static class Base32Text
{
    private const string Alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ234567";

    public static string Encode(ReadOnlySpan<byte> bytes)
    {
        if (bytes.IsEmpty)
        {
            return string.Empty;
        }

        char[] buffer = new char[((bytes.Length * 8) + 4) / 5];
        int cursor = 0;
        int bitBuffer = 0;
        int bitCount = 0;

        foreach (byte value in bytes)
        {
            bitBuffer = (bitBuffer << 8) | value;
            bitCount += 8;
            while (bitCount >= 5)
            {
                bitCount -= 5;
                buffer[cursor++] = Alphabet[(bitBuffer >> bitCount) & 0x1F];
            }
        }

        if (bitCount > 0)
        {
            buffer[cursor++] = Alphabet[(bitBuffer << (5 - bitCount)) & 0x1F];
        }

        return new string(buffer, 0, cursor);
    }

    public static bool TryDecode(string text, out byte[] bytes)
    {
        bytes = [];
        if (text is null)
        {
            return false;
        }

        int end = text.Length;
        while (end > 0 && text[end - 1] == '=')
        {
            end--;
        }

        List<byte> output = new(end * 5 / 8);
        int bitBuffer = 0;
        int bitCount = 0;

        for (int index = 0; index < end; index++)
        {
            char character = char.ToUpperInvariant(text[index]);
            if (character is ' ' or '-')
            {
                continue;
            }

            int value;
            if (character is >= 'A' and <= 'Z')
            {
                value = character - 'A';
            }
            else if (character is >= '2' and <= '7')
            {
                value = character - '2' + 26;
            }
            else
            {
                return false;
            }

            bitBuffer = (bitBuffer << 5) | value;
            bitCount += 5;
            if (bitCount >= 8)
            {
                bitCount -= 8;
                output.Add((byte)((bitBuffer >> bitCount) & 0xFF));
            }
        }

        if (bitCount >= 5 || (bitBuffer & ((1 << bitCount) - 1)) != 0)
        {
            return false;
        }

        bytes = [.. output];
        return true;
    }
}

namespace MyRestaurant.Domain.Security;

public static class Base64UrlText
{
    public static string Encode(ReadOnlySpan<byte> bytes)
    {
        string standard = Convert.ToBase64String(bytes);
        return standard.TrimEnd('=').Replace('+', '-').Replace('/', '_');
    }

    public static bool TryDecode(string text, out byte[] bytes)
    {
        bytes = [];
        if (text is null)
        {
            return false;
        }

        string standard = text.Replace('-', '+').Replace('_', '/');
        switch (standard.Length % 4)
        {
            case 2: standard += "=="; break;
            case 3: standard += "="; break;
            case 1: return false;
        }

        try
        {
            bytes = Convert.FromBase64String(standard);
            return true;
        }
        catch (FormatException)
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
}

using System.Globalization;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;

namespace MyRestaurant.Domain.Security;

public enum JoinTokenValidationResult
{
    Valid,
    Expired,
    Invalid,
}

public static class JoinTokenService
{
    public const int DefaultExpiredLookbackWindows = 10;

    public static long CurrentWindowIndex(DateTimeOffset instant, int rotationSeconds)
    {
        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfLessThan(rotationSeconds, 1);
        return instant.ToUnixTimeSeconds() / rotationSeconds;
    }

    public static string ComputeToken(ReadOnlySpan<byte> joinSecret, Guid tableIdentifier, long windowIndex)
    {
        string message = string.Concat(
            tableIdentifier.ToString("D").ToLowerInvariant(),
            ":",
            windowIndex.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));

        byte[] mac = HMACSHA256.HashData(joinSecret, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(message));
        return Base64UrlText.Encode(mac);
    }

    public static string ComputeCurrentToken(ReadOnlySpan<byte> joinSecret, Guid tableIdentifier, DateTimeOffset instant, int rotationSeconds)
        => ComputeToken(joinSecret, tableIdentifier, CurrentWindowIndex(instant, rotationSeconds));

    public static string BuildJoinUrl(string publicOrigin, Guid tableIdentifier, string token)
        => $"{publicOrigin.TrimEnd('/')}/table/{tableIdentifier:D}?token={token}";

    public static DateTimeOffset NextRotationInstant(DateTimeOffset instant, int rotationSeconds)
    {
        long nextWindow = CurrentWindowIndex(instant, rotationSeconds) + 1;
        return DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeSeconds(nextWindow * rotationSeconds);
    }

    public static JoinTokenValidationResult Validate(
        ReadOnlySpan<byte> joinSecret,
        Guid tableIdentifier,
        string presentedToken,
        DateTimeOffset instant,
        int rotationSeconds,
        int expiredLookbackWindows = DefaultExpiredLookbackWindows)
    {
        if (!Base64UrlText.TryDecode(presentedToken, out byte[] presented) || presented.Length != Sha256Hashing.HashByteCount)
        {
            return JoinTokenValidationResult.Invalid;
        }

        long currentWindow = CurrentWindowIndex(instant, rotationSeconds);

        if (MatchesWindow(joinSecret, tableIdentifier, currentWindow, presented)
            || MatchesWindow(joinSecret, tableIdentifier, currentWindow - 1, presented))
        {
            return JoinTokenValidationResult.Valid;
        }

        for (long window = currentWindow - 2; window >= currentWindow - 1 - expiredLookbackWindows; window--)
        {
            if (MatchesWindow(joinSecret, tableIdentifier, window, presented))
            {
                return JoinTokenValidationResult.Expired;
            }
        }

        return JoinTokenValidationResult.Invalid;
    }

    private static bool MatchesWindow(ReadOnlySpan<byte> joinSecret, Guid tableIdentifier, long windowIndex, ReadOnlySpan<byte> presented)
    {
        string message = string.Concat(
            tableIdentifier.ToString("D").ToLowerInvariant(),
            ":",
            windowIndex.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));

        byte[] computed = HMACSHA256.HashData(joinSecret, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(message));
        return CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals(computed, presented);
    }
}

using System.Security.Cryptography;

namespace MyRestaurant.Domain.Security;

public static class PairingCode
{
    public const string Alphabet = "ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789";

    public const int Length = 8;

    public static string Generate()
    {
        char[] buffer = new char[Length];
        for (int index = 0; index < Length; index++)
        {
            buffer[index] = Alphabet[RandomNumberGenerator.GetInt32(Alphabet.Length)];
        }

        return new string(buffer);
    }

    public static bool IsWellFormed(string code)
        => code is { Length: Length } && code.All(character => Alphabet.Contains(character, StringComparison.Ordinal));

    public static string Normalize(string? presentedCode)
    {
        const int maximumPresentedLength = 128;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(presentedCode) || presentedCode.Length > maximumPresentedLength)
        {
            return string.Empty;
        }

        Span<char> buffer = stackalloc char[maximumPresentedLength];
        int written = 0;

        foreach (char character in presentedCode)
        {
            if (char.IsWhiteSpace(character) || IsSeparator(character))
            {
                continue;
            }

            buffer[written++] = char.ToUpperInvariant(character);
        }

        return new string(buffer[..written]);
    }

    private static bool IsSeparator(char character)
        => character is '-' or '_' or '.' or '\u2010' or '\u2011' or '\u2012' or '\u2013' or '\u2014';
}

using System.Security.Cryptography;

namespace MyRestaurant.Domain.Security;

public static class RecoveryCode
{
    public const int CodesPerSet = 10;
    public const int GroupLength = 5;

    public static string GenerateOne()
    {
        char[] buffer = new char[(GroupLength * 2) + 1];
        int cursor = 0;
        for (int group = 0; group < 2; group++)
        {
            if (group == 1)
            {
                buffer[cursor++] = '-';
            }

            for (int index = 0; index < GroupLength; index++)
            {
                buffer[cursor++] = PairingCode.Alphabet[RandomNumberGenerator.GetInt32(PairingCode.Alphabet.Length)];
            }
        }

        return new string(buffer);
    }

    public static IReadOnlyList<string> GenerateSet()
    {
        HashSet<string> codes = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        while (codes.Count < CodesPerSet)
        {
            codes.Add(GenerateOne());
        }

        return [.. codes];
    }
}

using System.Buffers.Binary;
using System.Security.Cryptography;

namespace MyRestaurant.Domain.Security;

public static class Rfc6238Totp
{
    public const int SecretSizeInBytes = 20;

    public const int CodeLength = 6;

    public const int TimeStepSeconds = 30;

    public const int AllowedStepSkew = 1;

    private const int Modulo = 1_000_000;

    public static byte[] GenerateSecret() => SecretGenerator.GenerateTotpSecret();

    public static string ComputeCode(ReadOnlySpan<byte> secret, DateTimeOffset timestamp)
        => ComputeCodeForStep(secret, StepNumber(timestamp));

    public static bool ValidateCode(
        ReadOnlySpan<byte> secret,
        string code,
        DateTimeOffset timestamp,
        int allowedStepSkew = AllowedStepSkew)
    {
        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegative(allowedStepSkew);

        if (code is null || code.Length != CodeLength)
        {
            return false;
        }

        foreach (char character in code)
        {
            if (character is < '0' or > '9')
            {
                return false;
            }
        }

        long currentStep = StepNumber(timestamp);
        ReadOnlySpan<byte> candidate = System.Text.Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(code);

        bool matched = false;
        for (int offset = -allowedStepSkew; offset <= allowedStepSkew; offset++)
        {
            long step = currentStep + offset;
            if (step < 0)
            {
                continue;
            }

            byte[] expected = System.Text.Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(ComputeCodeForStep(secret, step));

            matched |= CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals(candidate, expected);
        }

        return matched;
    }

    private static long StepNumber(DateTimeOffset timestamp)
        => timestamp.ToUnixTimeSeconds() / TimeStepSeconds;

    private static string ComputeCodeForStep(ReadOnlySpan<byte> secret, long step)
    {
        Span<byte> counter = stackalloc byte[8];
        BinaryPrimitives.WriteInt64BigEndian(counter, step);

        Span<byte> mac = stackalloc byte[HMACSHA1.HashSizeInBytes];
        HMACSHA1.HashData(secret, counter, mac);

        int offset = mac[^1] & 0x0F;
        int binary =
            ((mac[offset] & 0x7F) << 24)
            | (mac[offset + 1] << 16)
            | (mac[offset + 2] << 8)
            | mac[offset + 3];

        return (binary % Modulo).ToString().PadLeft(CodeLength, '0');
    }
}

{
    public static string Build(string issuer, string username, string base32Secret)
    {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrEmpty(issuer);
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrEmpty(username);

namespace MyRestaurant.WebApplication.Authorization;

public static class RestaurantRoles
{
    public const string Administrator = "administrator";
    public const string Kitchen = "kitchen";
    public const string Counter = "counter";
}

public static class AuthorizationPolicies
{
    public const string Table = "area.table";

    public const string Kitchen = "area.kitchen";

    public const string Counter = "area.counter";

    public const string Administration = "area.administration";
}

public static class AuthorizationServiceCollectionExtensions
{
    public static IServiceCollection AddRestaurantAuthorization(this IServiceCollection services)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(services);

        services.AddAuthorizationBuilder()
            .AddPolicy(AuthorizationPolicies.Table, policy => policy
                .RequireAuthenticatedUser())
            .AddPolicy(AuthorizationPolicies.Kitchen, policy => policy
                .RequireAuthenticatedUser()
                .RequireRole(RestaurantRoles.Kitchen, RestaurantRoles.Administrator))
            .AddPolicy(AuthorizationPolicies.Counter, policy => policy
                .RequireAuthenticatedUser()
                .RequireRole(RestaurantRoles.Counter, RestaurantRoles.Administrator))
            .AddPolicy(AuthorizationPolicies.Administration, policy => policy
                .RequireAuthenticatedUser()
                .RequireRole(RestaurantRoles.Administrator));

        return services;
    }
}

@code {
    private readonly List<string> _errors = [];

    private Person? _person;
    private bool _hasPassword;

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "change-password")]
    private ChangePasswordInputModel ChangeInput { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "add-password")]
    private AddPasswordInputModel AddInput { get; set; } = default!;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        ChangeInput ??= new();
        AddInput ??= new();

        Person? user = await UserManager.GetUserAsync(HttpContext.User);
        if (user is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(AccountRoutes.SignIn);
            return;
        }

        _person = user;
        _hasPassword = user.PasswordHash is not null;
    }

    private async Task ChangeAsync()
    {
        Person? user = _person;
        if (user is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(AccountRoutes.SignIn);
            return;
        }

        IdentityResult result = await UserManager.ChangePasswordAsync(
            user,
            ChangeInput.CurrentPassword,
            ChangeInput.NewPassword);

        if (!result.Succeeded)
        {
            _errors.Clear();
            _errors.AddRange(result.Errors.Select(error => error.Description));
            return;
        }

        await CompleteAsync(user, "password-changed");
    }

    private async Task AddAsync()
    {
        Person? user = _person;
        if (user is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(AccountRoutes.SignIn);
            return;
        }

        IdentityResult result = await UserManager.AddPasswordAsync(user, AddInput.NewPassword);

        if (!result.Succeeded)
        {
            _errors.Clear();
            _errors.AddRange(result.Errors.Select(error => error.Description));
            return;
        }

        await CompleteAsync(user, "password-added");
    }

    private async Task CompleteAsync(Person user, string outcome)
    {
        await SecurityEventLog.RecordAsync(
            user.PersonIdentifier,
            actorPersonIdentifier: null,
            SecurityEventType.PasswordChanged);

        await SignInManager.RefreshSignInAsync(user);

        Navigation.NavigateTo($"{AccountRoutes.Profile}?done={outcome}");
    }

    private sealed class ChangePasswordInputModel
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Enter your current password.")]
        public string CurrentPassword { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Choose a new password.")]
        [MinLength(12, ErrorMessage = "Passwords are at least 12 characters (§3.2) — a short sentence works.")]
        public string NewPassword { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Repeat the new password.")]
        [Compare(nameof(NewPassword), ErrorMessage = "The two entries do not match.")]
        public string ConfirmPassword { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }

    private sealed class AddPasswordInputModel
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Choose a password.")]
        [MinLength(12, ErrorMessage = "Passwords are at least 12 characters (§3.2) — a short sentence works.")]
        public string NewPassword { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Repeat the password.")]
        [Compare(nameof(NewPassword), ErrorMessage = "The two entries do not match.")]
        public string ConfirmPassword { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }
}

@code {
    private readonly List<string> _errors = [];

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm]
    private ChangePasswordInputModel Input { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private string? ReturnUrl { get; set; }

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        Input ??= new();

        Person? user = await UserManager.GetUserAsync(HttpContext.User);
        if (user is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(AccountRoutes.SignIn);
            return;
        }

        if (!user.MustChangePassword && HttpContext.Request.Method == HttpMethods.Get)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(ObligationsEnforcement.SafeLocalReturnUrl(ReturnUrl));
        }
    }

    private async Task ChangePasswordAsync()
    {
        Person? user = await UserManager.GetUserAsync(HttpContext.User);
        if (user is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(AccountRoutes.SignIn);
            return;
        }

        string destination = ObligationsEnforcement.SafeLocalReturnUrl(ReturnUrl);

        if (!user.MustChangePassword)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(destination);
            return;
        }

        user.MustChangePassword = false;
        IdentityResult result = await UserManager.ChangePasswordAsync(
            user,
            Input.CurrentPassword,
            Input.NewPassword);

        if (!result.Succeeded)
        {
            user.MustChangePassword = true;
            _errors.Clear();
            _errors.AddRange(result.Errors.Select(error => error.Description));
            return;
        }

        await SecurityEventLog.RecordAsync(
            user.PersonIdentifier,
            actorPersonIdentifier: null,
            SecurityEventType.ForcedPasswordChangeCompleted);

        await SignInManager.RefreshSignInAsync(user);

        Navigation.NavigateTo(destination);
    }

    private sealed class ChangePasswordInputModel
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Enter the temporary password you signed in with.")]
        public string CurrentPassword { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Choose a new password.")]
        [MinLength(12, ErrorMessage = "Passwords are at least 12 characters (§3.2) — a short sentence works.")]
        public string NewPassword { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Repeat the new password.")]
        [Compare(nameof(NewPassword), ErrorMessage = "The two entries do not match.")]
        public string ConfirmPassword { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }
}

@code {
    private bool _enrolled;
    private int _remainingRecoveryCodes;
    private TotpEnrollmentStart? _start;
    private IReadOnlyList<string>? _recoveryCodes;
    private string? _recoveryCodesLede;
    private string? _errorMessage;

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "enroll-totp-confirm")]
    private ConfirmInputModel ConfirmInput { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "enroll-totp-regenerate")]
    private RegenerateInputModel RegenerateInput { get; set; } = default!;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        ConfirmInput ??= new();
        RegenerateInput ??= new();

        Person? user = await UserManager.GetUserAsync(HttpContext.User);
        if (user is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(AccountRoutes.SignIn);
            return;
        }

        _enrolled = await UserManager.GetTwoFactorEnabledAsync(user);
        if (_enrolled)
        {
            _remainingRecoveryCodes = await Enrollment.CountRecoveryCodesAsync(user, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        }
        else
        {
            _start = Enrollment.BeginEnrollment(user);
        }
    }

    private async Task ConfirmAsync()
    {
        Person? user = await UserManager.GetUserAsync(HttpContext.User);
        if (user is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(AccountRoutes.SignIn);
            return;
        }

        if (await UserManager.GetTwoFactorEnabledAsync(user))
        {
            _enrolled = true;
            _start = null;
            _remainingRecoveryCodes = await Enrollment.CountRecoveryCodesAsync(user, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
            return;
        }

        (TotpEnrollmentConfirmation confirmation, TotpEnrollmentResult? result) = await Enrollment.ConfirmAsync(
            user,
            ConfirmInput.ProtectedTicket,
            ConfirmInput.Code,
            forced: false,
            HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        switch (confirmation)
        {
            case TotpEnrollmentConfirmation.Succeeded:

                await SignInManager.RefreshSignInAsync(user);
                _recoveryCodes = result!.RecoveryCodes;
                _recoveryCodesLede = "Your authenticator is now enrolled.";
                _enrolled = true;
                _start = null;
                break;

            case TotpEnrollmentConfirmation.InvalidCode:

                _errorMessage = "That code did not verify. Codes rotate every 30 seconds — check the app and try the current one.";
                _start = Enrollment.ResumeEnrollment(user, ConfirmInput.ProtectedTicket) ?? Enrollment.BeginEnrollment(user);
                break;

            case TotpEnrollmentConfirmation.TicketInvalid:
            default:

                _errorMessage = "This setup step expired. Scan the new QR code and enter a fresh six-digit code.";
                _start = Enrollment.BeginEnrollment(user);
                break;
        }
    }

    private async Task RegenerateAsync()
    {
        Person? user = await UserManager.GetUserAsync(HttpContext.User);
        if (user is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(AccountRoutes.SignIn);
            return;
        }

        if (!await UserManager.GetTwoFactorEnabledAsync(user))
        {
            _enrolled = false;
            _start = Enrollment.BeginEnrollment(user);
            return;
        }

        TotpEnrollmentResult result = await Enrollment.RegenerateRecoveryCodesAsync(user, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        _recoveryCodes = result.RecoveryCodes;
        _recoveryCodesLede = "Your recovery codes have been regenerated.";
        _enrolled = true;
    }

    private sealed class ConfirmInputModel
    {
        public string ProtectedTicket { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.")]
        public string Code { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }

    private sealed class RegenerateInputModel
    {
    }
}

@code {
    private IList<UserPasskeyInfo>? _passkeys;
    private string? _statusMessage;
    private string? _errorMessage;

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "add-passkey")]
    private PasskeyInputModel Input { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm]
    private string? Action { get; set; }

    [SupplyParameterFromForm]
    private string? CredentialId { get; set; }

    [SupplyParameterFromForm]
    private string? NewName { get; set; }

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery(Name = "status")]
    private string? Status { get; set; }

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        Input ??= new();
        _statusMessage = Status;

        Person? user = await UserManager.GetUserAsync(HttpContext.User);
        if (user is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(AccountRoutes.SignIn);
            return;
        }

        _passkeys = await UserManager.GetPasskeysAsync(user);
    }

    private async Task AddPasskeyAsync()
    {
        Person? user = await UserManager.GetUserAsync(HttpContext.User);
        if (user is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(AccountRoutes.SignIn);
            return;
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Input.Error))
        {
            await FailAsync(user, "That passkey could not be added. Please try again.");
            return;
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Input.CredentialJson))
        {
            await FailAsync(user, "Your browser did not provide a passkey.");
            return;
        }

        PasskeyAttestationResult attestation = await SignInManager.PerformPasskeyAttestationAsync(Input.CredentialJson);
        if (!attestation.Succeeded || attestation.Passkey is null)
        {
            await FailAsync(user, "That passkey could not be registered. Please try again.");
            return;
        }

        UserPasskeyInfo passkey = attestation.Passkey;
        passkey.Name = $"Passkey added {RestaurantClock.Date(DateTimeOffset.UtcNow)}";

        IdentityResult added = await UserManager.AddOrUpdatePasskeyAsync(user, passkey);
        if (!added.Succeeded)
        {
            await FailAsync(user, "The passkey could not be saved to your account.");
            return;
        }

        await SecurityEventLog.RecordAsync(
            user.PersonIdentifier, actorPersonIdentifier: null, SecurityEventType.PasskeyRegistered, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        Redirect("Passkey added. You can rename it below.");
    }

    private async Task UpdatePasskeyAsync()
    {
        Person? user = await UserManager.GetUserAsync(HttpContext.User);
        if (user is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(AccountRoutes.SignIn);
            return;
        }

        byte[] credentialId;
        try
        {
            credentialId = Base64Url.DecodeFromChars(CredentialId);
        }
        catch (FormatException)
        {
            await FailAsync(user, "That passkey could not be identified.");
            return;
        }

        if (string.Equals(Action, "delete", StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            IdentityResult removed = await UserManager.RemovePasskeyAsync(user, credentialId);
            if (!removed.Succeeded)
            {
                await FailAsync(user, "The passkey could not be removed.");
                return;
            }

            await SecurityEventLog.RecordAsync(
                user.PersonIdentifier, actorPersonIdentifier: null, SecurityEventType.PasskeyRemoved, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
            Redirect("Passkey removed.");
            return;
        }

        if (string.Equals(Action, "rename", StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            UserPasskeyInfo? existing = await UserManager.GetPasskeyAsync(user, credentialId);
            if (existing is null)
            {
                await FailAsync(user, "That passkey no longer exists.");
                return;
            }

            existing.Name = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(NewName) ? existing.Name : NewName.Trim();
            IdentityResult renamed = await UserManager.AddOrUpdatePasskeyAsync(user, existing);
            if (!renamed.Succeeded)
            {
                await FailAsync(user, "The passkey could not be renamed.");
                return;
            }

            Redirect("Passkey renamed.");
            return;
        }

        await FailAsync(user, "That action was not recognized.");
    }

    private async Task FailAsync(Person user, string message)
    {
        _errorMessage = message;
        _passkeys = await UserManager.GetPasskeysAsync(user);
    }

    private void Redirect(string status)
        => Navigation.NavigateTo($"{AccountRoutes.Passkeys}?status={Uri.EscapeDataString(status)}");
}

@code {
    private readonly List<string> _errors = [];

    private Person? _person;
    private IList<string> _roles = [];
    private int _passkeyCount;
    private string? _flashMessage;

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "account-details")]
    private ProfileInputModel Input { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private string? Done { get; set; }

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        Input ??= new();

        Person? user = await UserManager.GetUserAsync(HttpContext.User);
        if (user is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(AccountRoutes.SignIn);
            return;
        }

        _person = user;
        _roles = await UserManager.GetRolesAsync(user);
        _passkeyCount = (await UserManager.GetPasskeysAsync(user)).Count;

        if (HttpContext.Request.Method == HttpMethods.Get)
        {
            Input.DisplayName = user.DisplayName;
            Input.EmailAddress = user.EmailAddress;
            Input.PhoneNumber = user.PhoneNumber;
            _flashMessage = FlashFor(Done);
        }
    }

    private async Task SaveDetailsAsync()
    {
        Person? user = _person;
        if (user is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(AccountRoutes.SignIn);
            return;
        }

        ProfileDetails details = ProfileDetails.Normalize(Input.DisplayName, Input.EmailAddress, Input.PhoneNumber);

        IReadOnlyList<string> problems = details.Validate();
        if (problems.Count > 0)
        {
            _errors.Clear();
            _errors.AddRange(problems);
            return;
        }

        if (details.SameAs(user.DisplayName, user.EmailAddress, user.PhoneNumber))
        {
            RedirectWithOutcome("details-unchanged");
            return;
        }

        bool displayNameChanged = !string.Equals(user.DisplayName, details.DisplayName, StringComparison.Ordinal);

        user.DisplayName = details.DisplayName;
        user.EmailAddress = details.EmailAddress;
        user.PhoneNumber = details.PhoneNumber;

        IdentityResult result = await UserManager.UpdateAsync(user);
        if (!result.Succeeded)
        {
            _errors.Clear();
            _errors.AddRange(result.Errors.Select(error => error.Description));
            return;
        }

        if (displayNameChanged)
        {
            await SignInManager.RefreshSignInAsync(user);
        }

        RedirectWithOutcome("details-saved");
    }

    private void RedirectWithOutcome(string outcome)
        => Navigation.NavigateTo($"{AccountRoutes.Profile}?done={outcome}");

    private static string? FlashFor(string? outcome) => outcome switch
    {
        "details-saved" => "Your details were saved.",
        "details-unchanged" => "Nothing changed.",
        "password-changed" => "Your password was changed.",
        "password-added" => "Your password was set. You can now sign in with it.",
        _ => null,
    };

    private sealed class ProfileInputModel
    {
        [StringLength(ProfileDetails.DisplayNameMaximumLength, ErrorMessage = "That display name is too long.")]
        public string? DisplayName { get; set; }

        [StringLength(ProfileDetails.EmailAddressMaximumLength, ErrorMessage = "That email address is too long.")]
        public string? EmailAddress { get; set; }

        [StringLength(ProfileDetails.PhoneNumberMaximumLength, ErrorMessage = "That phone number is too long.")]
        public string? PhoneNumber { get; set; }
    }
}

@code {
    private const int MinimumPasswordLength = 12;

    private RegistrationTicketProtector _protector = default!;
    private RegistrationTicket? _ticket;
    private bool _alreadySignedIn;
    private string? _errorMessage;

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "register-details")]
    private DetailsInputModel DetailsInput { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "register-passkey")]
    private PasskeyInputModel PasskeyInput { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private string? ReturnUrl { get; set; }

    private string SafeReturnUrl => ObligationsEnforcement.SafeLocalReturnUrl(ReturnUrl);

    private string SelfUrl => string.IsNullOrEmpty(ReturnUrl)
        ? AccountRoutes.Register
        : $"{AccountRoutes.Register}?ReturnUrl={Uri.EscapeDataString(ReturnUrl)}";

    private string SignInUrl => string.IsNullOrEmpty(ReturnUrl)
        ? AccountRoutes.SignIn
        : $"{AccountRoutes.SignIn}?ReturnUrl={Uri.EscapeDataString(ReturnUrl)}";

    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        DetailsInput ??= new();
        PasskeyInput ??= new();
        _protector = new RegistrationTicketProtector(DataProtection);

        if (HttpContext.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true)
        {
            _alreadySignedIn = true;
            return;
        }

        if (HttpContext.Request.Cookies.TryGetValue(RegistrationCookie.Name, out string? cookie)
            && _protector.TryUnprotect(cookie, out RegistrationTicket? ticket)
            && ticket is not null
            && !ticket.HasExpired(Clock.UtcNow, RegistrationCookie.Lifetime))
        {
            _ticket = ticket;
        }
        else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(cookie))
        {
            RegistrationCookie.Delete(HttpContext.Response);
            _errorMessage = "That took a while, so we started over. Please fill this in again.";
        }
    }

    private async Task StartAsync()
    {
        if (_alreadySignedIn)
        {
            return;
        }

        string username = DetailsInput.Username.Trim();
        string? displayName = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(DetailsInput.DisplayName)
            ? null
            : DetailsInput.DisplayName.Trim();

        if (await UserManager.FindByNameAsync(username) is not null)
        {
            _errorMessage = "That username is already taken. Please choose another.";
            return;
        }

        Guid personIdentifier = IdentifierFactory.Create();

        string? passwordHash = string.IsNullOrEmpty(DetailsInput.Password)
            ? null
            : PasswordHasher.HashPassword(
                new Person { PersonIdentifier = personIdentifier, Username = username },
                DetailsInput.Password);

        WriteTicketAndReload(new RegistrationTicket(
            personIdentifier,
            Clock.UtcNow,
            username,
            displayName,
            passwordHash));
    }

    private async Task RegisterPasskeyAsync()
    {
        if (_alreadySignedIn)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (_ticket is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(SelfUrl);
            return;
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(PasskeyInput.Error))
        {
            _errorMessage = "That passkey could not be added. Please try again.";
            return;
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(PasskeyInput.CredentialJson))
        {
            _errorMessage = "Your browser did not provide a passkey.";
            return;
        }

        PasskeyAttestationResult attestation =
            await SignInManager.PerformPasskeyAttestationAsync(PasskeyInput.CredentialJson);
        if (!attestation.Succeeded || attestation.Passkey is null)
        {
            _errorMessage = "That passkey could not be registered. Please try again.";
            return;
        }

        UserPasskeyInfo verified = attestation.Passkey;

        UserPasskeyInfo passkey = new(
            verified.CredentialId,
            verified.PublicKey,
            Clock.UtcNow,
            verified.SignCount,
            verified.Transports,
            verified.IsUserVerified,
            verified.IsBackupEligible,
            verified.IsBackedUp,
            attestationObject: [],
            clientDataJson: [])
        {
            Name = $"Passkey added {RestaurantClock.Date(Clock.UtcNow)}",
        };

        await CommitAsync(_ticket, passkey);
    }

    private async Task FinishWithPasswordOnlyAsync()
    {
        if (_alreadySignedIn)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (_ticket is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(SelfUrl);
            return;
        }

        if (!_ticket.CanDeclineThePasskey)
        {
            _errorMessage = "You have not set a password, so you will need a passkey to sign in.";
            return;
        }

        await CommitAsync(_ticket, passkey: null);
    }

    private async Task CommitAsync(RegistrationTicket ticket, UserPasskeyInfo? passkey)
    {
        GuestRegistrationStatus status = await Registration.RegisterAsync(
            new NewGuestAccount(
                ticket.PersonIdentifier,
                ticket.Username,
                ticket.DisplayName,
                ticket.PasswordHash,
                passkey),
            HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        if (status == GuestRegistrationStatus.UsernameTaken)
        {
            RegistrationCookie.Delete(HttpContext.Response);
            _ticket = null;
            _errorMessage = "That username was taken while you were signing up. Please try another.";
            return;
        }

        RegistrationCookie.Delete(HttpContext.Response);

        Person? guest = await UserManager.FindByIdAsync(ticket.PersonIdentifier.ToString());
        if (guest is not null)
        {
            await SignInManager.SignInAsync(guest, isPersistent: true);
        }

        Navigation.NavigateTo(SafeReturnUrl);
    }

    private void RestartAsync()
    {
        RegistrationCookie.Delete(HttpContext.Response);
        Navigation.NavigateTo(SelfUrl);
    }

    private void WriteTicketAndReload(RegistrationTicket ticket)
    {
        RegistrationCookie.Write(HttpContext.Response, _protector.Protect(ticket));
        Navigation.NavigateTo(SelfUrl);
    }

    private int ActiveStepIndex => _ticket is null ? 0 : 1;

    private string StepClass(int index)
        => index == ActiveStepIndex ? "setup-step is-current"
            : index < ActiveStepIndex ? "setup-step is-done"
            : "setup-step";

    private sealed class DetailsInputModel : IValidatableObject
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Choose a username.")]
        [StringLength(64, MinimumLength = 3, ErrorMessage = "The username must be 3–64 characters.")]
        public string Username { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        [StringLength(120, ErrorMessage = "That display name is too long.")]
        public string? DisplayName { get; set; }

        [StringLength(256, ErrorMessage = "That password is too long.")]
        public string? Password { get; set; }

        public string? ConfirmPassword { get; set; }

        public IEnumerable<ValidationResult> Validate(ValidationContext validationContext)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Password))
            {
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ConfirmPassword))
                {
                    yield return new ValidationResult(
                        "Enter the password in both fields, or leave both blank to use a passkey.",
                        [nameof(Password)]);
                }

                yield break;
            }

            if (Password.Length < MinimumPasswordLength)
            {
                yield return new ValidationResult(
                    $"Use at least {MinimumPasswordLength} characters, or leave it blank to use a passkey.",
                    [nameof(Password)]);
            }

            if (!string.Equals(Password, ConfirmPassword, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                yield return new ValidationResult("The passwords do not match.", [nameof(ConfirmPassword)]);
            }
        }
    }
}

@code {
    private string? _errorMessage;
    private EditContext _editContext = default!;

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm]
    private SignInInputModel Input { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private string? ReturnUrl { get; set; }

    private string RegisterUrl => string.IsNullOrEmpty(ReturnUrl)
        ? AccountRoutes.Register
        : $"{AccountRoutes.Register}?ReturnUrl={Uri.EscapeDataString(ReturnUrl)}";

    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        Input ??= new();
        _editContext = new EditContext(Input);
    }

    private async Task SignInUserAsync()
    {
        string destination = ObligationsEnforcement.SafeLocalReturnUrl(ReturnUrl);

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Input.Passkey?.Error))
        {
            _errorMessage = "That passkey could not be used. Try again, or sign in with your password.";
            return;
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Input.Passkey?.CredentialJson))
        {
            SignInResult passkeyResult = await SignInManager.PasskeySignInAsync(Input.Passkey.CredentialJson);

            if (passkeyResult.Succeeded)
            {
                Navigation.NavigateTo(destination);
            }
            else if (passkeyResult.IsLockedOut)
            {
                _errorMessage = "Too many failed attempts. The account is locked for about five minutes — try again then.";
            }
            else if (passkeyResult.IsNotAllowed)
            {
                _errorMessage = "This account has been deactivated. Ask at the counter if you think that is a mistake.";
            }
            else
            {
                _errorMessage = "That passkey did not work. Try again, or sign in with your password.";
            }

            return;
        }

        if (!_editContext.Validate())
        {
            return;
        }

        SignInResult result = await SignInManager.PasswordSignInAsync(
            Input.Username,
            Input.Password,
            isPersistent: true,
            lockoutOnFailure: true);

        if (result.Succeeded)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(destination);
        }
        else if (result.RequiresTwoFactor)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(
                $"{AccountRoutes.SignInTwoFactor}?ReturnUrl={Uri.EscapeDataString(destination)}");
        }
        else if (result.IsLockedOut)
        {
            _errorMessage = "Too many failed attempts. The account is locked for about five minutes — try again then.";
        }
        else if (result.IsNotAllowed)
        {
            _errorMessage = "This account has been deactivated. Ask at the counter if you think that is a mistake.";
        }
        else
        {
            _errorMessage = "That username and password combination did not work.";
        }
    }

    private sealed class SignInInputModel
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Enter your username.")]
        public string Username { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Enter your password.")]
        public string Password { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        public PasskeyInputModel? Passkey { get; set; }
    }
}

        </div>

    </p>

@code {
    private string? _errorMessage;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm]
    private TwoFactorInputModel Input { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private string? ReturnUrl { get; set; }

    private string RecoveryCodeHref
        => $"{AccountRoutes.SignInRecoveryCode}?ReturnUrl={Uri.EscapeDataString(ObligationsEnforcement.SafeLocalReturnUrl(ReturnUrl))}";

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        Input ??= new();

        if (await SignInManager.GetTwoFactorAuthenticationUserAsync() is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(AccountRoutes.SignIn);
        }
    }

    private async Task VerifyCodeAsync()
    {
        if (await SignInManager.GetTwoFactorAuthenticationUserAsync() is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(AccountRoutes.SignIn);
            return;
        }

        string code = Input.Code.Replace(" ", string.Empty).Replace("-", string.Empty);

        SignInResult result = await SignInManager.TwoFactorAuthenticatorSignInAsync(
            code,
            isPersistent: true,
            rememberClient: false);

        if (result.Succeeded)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(ObligationsEnforcement.SafeLocalReturnUrl(ReturnUrl));
        }
        else if (result.IsLockedOut)
        {
            _errorMessage = "Too many failed attempts. The account is locked for about five minutes — try again then.";
        }
        else
        {
            _errorMessage = "That code did not verify. Codes rotate every 30 seconds — check the app and try the current one.";
        }
    }

    private sealed class TwoFactorInputModel
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Enter the six-digit code.")]
        public string Code { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }

        and order history keep their actors (F-10b).
    </p>

@code {
    private const int RecentActivityCount = 20;

    private IReadOnlyList<MenuSectionSummary>? _sections;
    private IReadOnlyList<MenuItemSummary> _items = [];

    private Dictionary<Guid, int> _likeCounts = new();

    private IReadOnlyList<MenuItemEventEntry>? _recent;
    private int _itemCount;
    private int _activeItemCount;
    private int _describedItemCount;
    private string? _flashMessage;
    private string? _errorMessage;

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private string? Done { get; set; }

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        _sections = await MenuSections.ListAsync(HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        _items = await MenuItems.ListAsync(HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        _likeCounts = (await MenuItemReactionReads.ListLikeCountsAsync(HttpContext.RequestAborted))
            .ToDictionary(count => count.MenuItemIdentifier, count => count.LikeCount);

        _itemCount = _items.Count;
        _activeItemCount = _items.Count(item => item.IsActive);
        _describedItemCount = _items.Count(item => item.Description.Length > 0);

        _recent = await MenuEvents.ListRecentAsync(RecentActivityCount, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        if (HttpMethods.IsGet(HttpContext.Request.Method))
        {
            _flashMessage = FlashFor(Done);
        }
    }

    private async Task MoveAsync(Guid menuSectionIdentifier, int offset)
    {
        if (_sections is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(IndexPath);
            return;
        }

        if (PersonPrincipal.IdentifierFor(HttpContext.User) is not { } administrator)
        {
            _errorMessage = "Your session could not be identified. Sign in again and retry.";
            return;
        }

        List<Guid> ordering = _sections.Select(summary => summary.MenuSectionIdentifier).ToList();

        int from = ordering.IndexOf(menuSectionIdentifier);
        int to = from + offset;

        if (from < 0 || to < 0 || to >= ordering.Count)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(IndexPath);
            return;
        }

        (ordering[from], ordering[to]) = (ordering[to], ordering[from]);

        ResequenceMenuSectionsOutcome outcome = await MenuChanges.ResequenceMenuSectionsAsync(
            ordering, administrator, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        switch (outcome)
        {
            case ResequenceMenuSectionsOutcome.Resequenced:
                RedirectWithOutcome("moved");
                break;
            case ResequenceMenuSectionsOutcome.NoChange:
                RedirectWithOutcome("move-no-change");
                break;
            case ResequenceMenuSectionsOutcome.MenuSectionSetChanged:
                RedirectWithOutcome("menu-changed");
                break;
        }
    }

    private async Task MoveItemAsync(Guid menuSectionIdentifier, Guid menuItemIdentifier, int offset)
    {
        if (_sections is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(IndexPath);
            return;
        }

        if (PersonPrincipal.IdentifierFor(HttpContext.User) is not { } administrator)
        {
            _errorMessage = "Your session could not be identified. Sign in again and retry.";
            return;
        }

        List<Guid> ordering = _items
            .Where(item => item.MenuSectionIdentifier == menuSectionIdentifier)
            .Select(item => item.MenuItemIdentifier)
            .ToList();

        int from = ordering.IndexOf(menuItemIdentifier);
        int to = from + offset;

        if (from < 0 || to < 0 || to >= ordering.Count)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(IndexPath);
            return;
        }

        (ordering[from], ordering[to]) = (ordering[to], ordering[from]);

        ResequenceMenuItemsOutcome outcome = await MenuChanges.ResequenceMenuItemsAsync(
            menuSectionIdentifier, ordering, administrator, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        switch (outcome)
        {
            case ResequenceMenuItemsOutcome.Resequenced:
                RedirectWithOutcome("item-moved");
                break;
            case ResequenceMenuItemsOutcome.NoChange:
                RedirectWithOutcome("item-move-no-change");
                break;
            case ResequenceMenuItemsOutcome.MenuItemSetChanged:
                RedirectWithOutcome("items-changed");
                break;
        }
    }

    private IReadOnlyList<MenuItemSummary> ItemsUnder(MenuSectionSummary section)
        => _items.Where(item => item.MenuSectionIdentifier == section.MenuSectionIdentifier).ToArray();

    private string ItemCountLabel(MenuSectionSummary section)
    {
        int count = ItemsUnder(section).Count;

        return count switch
        {
            0 => "no items",
            1 => "1 item",
            _ => $"{count} items",
        };
    }

    private bool IsFirst(MenuSectionSummary menuSectionSummary)
        => _sections is null
            || _sections.Count == 0
            || _sections[0].MenuSectionIdentifier == menuSectionSummary.MenuSectionIdentifier;

    private bool IsLast(MenuSectionSummary menuSectionSummary)
        => _sections is null
            || _sections.Count == 0
            || _sections[^1].MenuSectionIdentifier == menuSectionSummary.MenuSectionIdentifier;

    private static string MoveFormName(MenuSectionSummary menuSectionSummary, bool up)
        => $"menu-section-move-{(up ? "up" : "down")}-{menuSectionSummary.MenuSectionIdentifier}";

    private bool IsFirstUnder(MenuSectionSummary section, MenuItemSummary item)
    {
        IReadOnlyList<MenuItemSummary> items = ItemsUnder(section);

        return items.Count == 0 || items[0].MenuItemIdentifier == item.MenuItemIdentifier;
    }

    private bool IsLastUnder(MenuSectionSummary section, MenuItemSummary item)
    {
        IReadOnlyList<MenuItemSummary> items = ItemsUnder(section);

        return items.Count == 0 || items[^1].MenuItemIdentifier == item.MenuItemIdentifier;
    }

    private static string ItemMoveFormName(MenuItemSummary item, bool up)
        => $"menu-item-move-{(up ? "up" : "down")}-{item.MenuItemIdentifier}";

    private static string IndexPath => "/administration/menu";

    private void RedirectWithOutcome(string outcome)
        => Navigation.NavigateTo($"{IndexPath}?done={outcome}");

    private static string? FlashFor(string? outcome) => outcome switch
    {
        "moved" => "Moved. Every open menu has already picked up the new order.",
        "move-no-change" => "It was already in that position — nothing changed.",
        "menu-changed" => "The headings changed while this page was open, so nothing was moved. This is"
            + " the current order; try again.",
        "item-moved" => "Moved. Every open menu has already picked up the new order.",
        "item-move-no-change" => "It was already in that position — nothing changed.",
        "items-changed" => "The items under that heading changed while this page was open, so nothing was"
            + " moved. This is the current order; try again.",
        _ => null,
    };

    private static string ManagePath(Guid menuItemIdentifier)
        => $"/administration/menu/{menuItemIdentifier}";

    private static string SectionPath(Guid menuSectionIdentifier)
        => $"/administration/menu/sections/{menuSectionIdentifier}";

    private int? LikeCount(MenuItemSummary item)
        => _likeCounts.TryGetValue(item.MenuItemIdentifier, out int likes) ? likes : null;

    private string Money(decimal amount) => MoneyText.Format(amount, Options.CurrencyCode);

    private string Describe(MenuItemEventEntry entry) => entry.EventType switch
    {
        "created" => $"Created at {Money(entry.NewPriceAmount ?? 0m)}",
        "name_changed" => $"Renamed to {entry.NewName}",
        "price_changed" => $"Repriced to {Money(entry.NewPriceAmount ?? 0m)}",
        "description_changed" => (entry.NewDescription ?? string.Empty).Length == 0
            ? "Description cleared"
            : "Description changed",
        "section_changed" => $"Filed under {entry.NewMenuSectionName}",
        "reordered" => $"Moved to position {entry.NewDisplayOrder}",
        "activated" => "Marked available",
        "deactivated" => "Marked unavailable",
        _ => entry.EventType,
    };
}

@code {
    private const string SelectedSittingField = "sitting";

    private const int RecentWindowDays = 7;

    private const int RecentCap = 60;

    private IReadOnlyList<CounterSittingSummary>? _open;
    private IReadOnlyList<CounterSittingSummary>? _closed;
    private int _pendingAcrossOpenSittings;
    private string? _flashMessage;
    private string? _errorMessage;

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private int? Closed { get; set; }

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private int? Already { get; set; }

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private int? Missing { get; set; }

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadAsync();

        if (HttpMethods.IsGet(HttpContext.Request.Method))
        {
            _flashMessage = FlashFor(Closed, Already, Missing);
        }
    }

    private async Task LoadAsync()
    {
        _open = await CounterReads.ListOpenSittingsAsync(HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        _pendingAcrossOpenSittings = _open.Sum(sitting => sitting.PendingLineCount);

        _closed = await CounterReads.ListRecentlyClosedSittingsAsync(
            Clock.UtcNow.AddDays(-RecentWindowDays),
            RecentCap,
            HttpContext.RequestAborted);
    }

    private async Task CloseSelectedAsync()
    {
        if (PersonPrincipal.IdentifierFor(HttpContext.User) is not { } administrator)
        {
            _errorMessage = "Your session could not be identified. Sign in again and retry.";
            await LoadAsync();
            return;
        }

        IFormCollection form = await HttpContext.Request.ReadFormAsync(HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        List<Guid> chosen = [];
        foreach (string? posted in form[SelectedSittingField])
        {
            if (Guid.TryParse(posted, out Guid sittingIdentifier))
            {
                chosen.Add(sittingIdentifier);
            }
        }

        if (chosen.Count == 0)
        {
            _errorMessage = "Nothing was ticked, so nothing was closed. Tick the tables that have finished.";
            await LoadAsync();
            return;
        }

        EndOfDayResult result = await Settlement.CloseManyAsync(
            chosen, administrator, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        Navigation.NavigateTo(
            $"/administration/sittings?closed={result.ClosedCount}" +
            $"&already={result.AlreadyClosedCount}" +
            $"&missing={result.NotFoundCount}");
    }

    private static string? FlashFor(int? closed, int? already, int? missing)
    {
        if (closed is null && already is null && missing is null)
        {
            return null;
        }

        int closedCount = closed ?? 0;
        int alreadyCount = already ?? 0;
        int missingCount = missing ?? 0;

        List<string> parts = [];

        parts.Add(closedCount == 1
            ? "Settled 1 sitting."
            : $"Settled {closedCount} sittings.");

        if (alreadyCount > 0)
        {
            parts.Add(alreadyCount == 1
                ? "1 had already been settled at the counter — nothing changed on it."
                : $"{alreadyCount} had already been settled at the counter — nothing changed on those.");
        }

        if (missingCount > 0)
        {
            parts.Add(missingCount == 1
                ? "1 no longer exists."
                : $"{missingCount} no longer exist.");
        }

        return string.Join(" ", parts);
    }

    private string AgeOf(DateTimeOffset instant)
    {
        TimeSpan elapsed = Clock.UtcNow - instant;

        if (elapsed < TimeSpan.Zero)
        {
            return string.Empty;
        }

        if (elapsed < TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1))
        {
            return "just now";
        }

        if (elapsed < TimeSpan.FromHours(1))
        {
            int minutes = (int)elapsed.TotalMinutes;
            return $"{minutes} {(minutes == 1 ? "minute" : "minutes")} ago";
        }

        if (elapsed < TimeSpan.FromDays(1))
        {
            int hours = (int)elapsed.TotalHours;
            return $"{hours} {(hours == 1 ? "hour" : "hours")} ago";
        }

        int days = (int)elapsed.TotalDays;
        return $"{days} {(days == 1 ? "day" : "days")} ago";
    }

    private static string CheckboxId(CounterSittingSummary sitting)
        => $"close-{sitting.SittingIdentifier}";

    private static string RecordPath(CounterSittingSummary sitting)
        => $"/administration/sittings/{sitting.SittingIdentifier}";

    private string Money(decimal amount) => MoneyText.Format(amount, Options.CurrencyCode);
}

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "create-menu-item")]
    private CreateMenuItemInputModel Input { get; set; } = default!;

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        Input ??= new();

        _sections = await MenuSections.ListAsync(HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        if (Input.MenuSectionIdentifier == Guid.Empty && _sections.Count > 0)
        {
            Input.MenuSectionIdentifier = _sections[0].MenuSectionIdentifier;
        }
    }

    private async Task CreateAsync()
    {
        if (PersonPrincipal.IdentifierFor(HttpContext.User) is not { } administrator)
        {
            _errorMessage = "Your session could not be identified. Sign in again and retry.";
            return;
        }

        _created = await MenuChanges.CreateMenuItemAsync(
            IdentifierFactory.Create(),
            Input.MenuSectionIdentifier,
            Input.Name.Trim(),
            Input.Description,
            Input.PriceAmount,
            administrator,
            HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        if (_created.Outcome is CreateMenuItemOutcome.MenuSectionNotFound)
        {
            _errorMessage =
                "That section no longer exists. It may have been changed while this page was open —"
                + " reload the page and choose again.";
        }
    }

    private string Money(decimal amount) => MoneyText.Format(amount, Options.CurrencyCode);

    private sealed class CreateMenuItemInputModel
    {
        public Guid MenuSectionIdentifier { get; set; }

        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Give the item a name.")]
        [StringLength(120, MinimumLength = 1, ErrorMessage = "The name must be 1–120 characters.")]
        public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        [StringLength(2000, ErrorMessage = "The description must be 2,000 characters or fewer.")]
        public string Description { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        [Range(0, 99999999.99, ErrorMessage = "The price must be between 0 and 99,999,999.99.")]
        public decimal PriceAmount { get; set; }
    }
