@code {
    private bool _created;
    private string? _createdUsername;
    private Guid _createdPersonIdentifier;
    private string? _temporaryPassword;
    private string? _grantedRolesText;
    private string? _errorMessage;

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "create-staff")]
    private CreateStaffInputModel Input { get; set; } = default!;

    protected override void OnInitialized()

        => Input ??= new();

    private async Task CreateAsync()
    {
        Person? actingAdministrator = await UserManager.GetUserAsync(HttpContext.User);
        if (actingAdministrator is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(AccountRoutes.SignIn);
            return;
        }

        string username = Input.Username.Trim();
        string? displayName = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Input.DisplayName) ? null : Input.DisplayName.Trim();

        if (await UserManager.FindByNameAsync(username) is not null)
        {
            _errorMessage = "That username is already taken. Please choose another.";
            return;
        }

        List<string> roles = [];
        if (Input.GrantAdministrator)
        {
            roles.Add(RestaurantRoles.Administrator);
        }

        if (Input.GrantCounter)
        {
            roles.Add(RestaurantRoles.Counter);
        }

        if (Input.GrantKitchen)
        {
            roles.Add(RestaurantRoles.Kitchen);
        }

        Guid personIdentifier = IdentifierFactory.Create();

        string temporaryPassword = SecretGenerator.GenerateBase64UrlSecret(12);
        string passwordHash = PasswordHasher.HashPassword(
            new Person { PersonIdentifier = personIdentifier, Username = username },
            temporaryPassword);

        CreateStaffStatus status = await Accounts.CreateStaffAsync(
            new NewStaffAccount(personIdentifier, username, displayName, passwordHash, roles),
            actingAdministrator.PersonIdentifier,
            HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        if (status == CreateStaffStatus.UsernameTaken)
        {
            _errorMessage = "That username was taken while you were filling this in. Please choose another.";
            return;
        }

        _createdUsername = username;
        _createdPersonIdentifier = personIdentifier;
        _temporaryPassword = temporaryPassword;
        _grantedRolesText = FormatRoles(roles);
        _created = true;
    }

    private static string? FormatRoles(IReadOnlyList<string> roles) => roles.Count switch
    {
        0 => null,
        1 => roles[0],
        _ => $"{string.Join(", ", roles.Take(roles.Count - 1))} and {roles[^1]}",
    };

    private sealed class CreateStaffInputModel
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Choose a username.")]
        [StringLength(64, MinimumLength = 3, ErrorMessage = "The username must be 3–64 characters.")]
        public string Username { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        [StringLength(120, ErrorMessage = "That display name is too long.")]
        public string? DisplayName { get; set; }

        public bool GrantAdministrator { get; set; }

        public bool GrantCounter { get; set; }

        public bool GrantKitchen { get; set; }
    }
}

@code {
    private bool _created;
    private string? _createdLabel;
    private Guid _createdTableIdentifier;
    private string? _errorMessage;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "create-table")]
    private CreateTableInputModel Input { get; set; } = default!;

    protected override void OnInitialized()

        => Input ??= new();

    private async Task CreateAsync()
    {
        string label = Input.Label.Trim();
        Guid tableIdentifier = IdentifierFactory.Create();

        CreateTableOutcome outcome = await Tables.CreateTableAsync(
            tableIdentifier, label, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        switch (outcome)
        {
            case CreateTableOutcome.Created:
                _createdLabel = label;
                _createdTableIdentifier = tableIdentifier;
                _created = true;
                break;
            case CreateTableOutcome.LabelTaken:
                _errorMessage = "That label is already used by another table. Please choose a different one.";
                break;
        }
    }

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    private sealed class CreateTableInputModel
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Choose a label for the table.")]
        [StringLength(64, MinimumLength = 1, ErrorMessage = "The label must be 1–64 characters.")]
        public string Label { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }
}

@code {
    private const int ListCap = 200;

    private EventExplorerQuery _query = default!;
    private IReadOnlyList<ExplorerEvent>? _events;

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery(Name = EventExplorerQuery.StreamField)]
    private string[]? Streams { get; set; }

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery(Name = EventExplorerQuery.SubjectField)]
    private string? Subject { get; set; }

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery(Name = EventExplorerQuery.ActorField)]
    private string? Actor { get; set; }

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery(Name = EventExplorerQuery.TypeField)]
    private string? EventTypeChoice { get; set; }

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery(Name = EventExplorerQuery.FromField)]
    private string? From { get; set; }

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery(Name = EventExplorerQuery.ToField)]
    private string? To { get; set; }

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        _query = EventExplorerQuery.Parse(
            Streams, Subject, Actor, EventTypeChoice, From, To, RestaurantClock);

        _events = await Explorer.ListAsync(_query.Filter, ListCap, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
    }

    private string CountSentence(int count)
    {
        string noun = count == 1 ? "event" : "events";
        string scope = _query.IsNarrowed ? "matching the filter" : "in total";

        return count == ListCap
            ? $"{count} {noun} {scope} — capped at {ListCap}; narrow the filter to see past it."
            : $"{count} {noun} {scope}.";
    }

    private string OnlyThisStreamPath(ExplorerEvent entry) => _query.PathWithStreams(
        entry.Stream == EventStream.Security,
        entry.Stream == EventStream.Order,
        entry.Stream == EventStream.Menu);

    private static string? SubjectPath(ExplorerEvent entry) => entry.Stream switch
    {
        EventStream.Security => $"/administration/people/{entry.SubjectIdentifier}",
        EventStream.Menu => $"/administration/menu/{entry.SubjectIdentifier}",
        EventStream.Order => entry.ContextIdentifier is { } sittingIdentifier
            ? $"/administration/sittings/{sittingIdentifier}"
            : null,
        _ => null,
    };

    private static string StreamLabel(string stream) => stream switch
    {
        EventStream.Security => "Security",
        EventStream.Order => "Order",
        EventStream.Menu => "Menu",
        _ => stream,
    };

    private static string DescribeEvent(ExplorerEvent entry) => entry.Stream switch
    {
        EventStream.Security => DescribeSecurityEventType(entry.EventType),
        EventStream.Order => DescribeOrderEventType(entry.EventType),
        EventStream.Menu => DescribeMenuEventType(entry.EventType),
        _ => entry.EventType,
    };

    private static string DescribeSecurityEventType(string eventType) => eventType switch
    {
        "account_created" => "Account created",
        "account_deactivated" => "Account deactivated",
        "account_reactivated" => "Account reactivated",
        "password_changed" => "Password changed",
        "password_reset_by_administrator" => "Password reset by an administrator",
        "forced_password_change_completed" => "Forced password change completed",
        "totp_enrolled" => "Authenticator enrolled",
        "totp_removed" => "Authenticator removed",
        "totp_cleared_by_administrator" => "Authenticator cleared by an administrator",
        "forced_totp_enrollment_completed" => "Forced authenticator enrollment completed",
        "recovery_code_used" => "Recovery code used",
        "recovery_codes_regenerated" => "Recovery codes regenerated",
        "passkey_registered" => "Passkey registered",
        "passkey_removed" => "Passkey removed",
        "role_granted" => "Role granted",
        "role_revoked" => "Role revoked",
        "sign_in_succeeded" => "Signed in",
        "sign_in_failed" => "Sign-in failed",
        "account_locked_out" => "Account locked out",
        _ => eventType,
    };

    private static string DescribeOrderEventType(string eventType) => eventType switch
    {
        "guest_submission" => "Guest send",
        "staff_edit" => "Staff edit",
        "price_adjustment" => "Price change",
        "fulfillment" => "Delivered",
        "fulfillment_reversal" => "Delivery undone",
        _ => eventType,
    };

    private static string DescribeMenuEventType(string eventType) => eventType switch
    {
        "created" => "Item created",
        "name_changed" => "Renamed",
        "price_changed" => "Repriced",
        "activated" => "Back on the menu",
        "deactivated" => "Off the menu (86'd)",
        _ => eventType,
    };

    private static string DescribeActorRole(string actorRole) => actorRole switch
    {
        "guest" => "a guest",
        "kitchen" => "the kitchen",
        "counter" => "the counter",
        "administrator" => "an administrator",
        _ => actorRole,
    };

    private string Money(decimal amount) => MoneyText.Format(amount, Options.CurrencyCode);
}

        <div class="form-field">
            <label for="filter-from">Sat down on or after</label>
            <input id="filter-from" name="from" type="date" value="@From" />
        </div>

        <div class="form-field">
            <label for="filter-to">On or before</label>
            <input id="filter-to" name="to" type="date" value="@To" />
        </div>

        <div class="form-field">
            <label for="filter-table">Table</label>
            <select id="filter-table" name="table">
                <option value="">Every table</option>
                @foreach (RestaurantTableSummary table in _tables)
                {
                    <option value="@table.TableIdentifier" selected="@(Table == table.TableIdentifier)">
                        @table.Label@(table.IsActive ? string.Empty : " (deactivated)")
                    </option>
                }
            </select>
        </div>

        <div class="filter-actions">
            <button type="submit" class="button-primary">Narrow the list</button>
            @if (_filter.IsNarrowed)
            {
                <a class="button-secondary" href="/administration/hidden-records">Show everything</a>
            }
        </div>
    </form>

    @if (_dateProblem is not null)
    {
        <p class="status-error" role="alert">@_dateProblem</p>
    }

    @if (_hidden is null)
    {
        <p class="record-empty">Loading…</p>
    }
    else if (_hidden.Count == 0)
    {
        <p class="record-empty hidden-none">
            @(_filter.IsNarrowed
                ? "Nothing hidden matches that. Widen the filter, or show everything."
                : "Nothing is hidden anywhere in the restaurant.")
        </p>
    }
    else
    {
        <p class="filter-count">@CountSentence(_hidden.Count)</p>

        @foreach (HiddenOrderSummary summary in _hidden)
        {
            <article class="hidden-record @(IsExpanded(summary) ? "hidden-record-open" : string.Empty)">
                <header class="hidden-record-header">
                    <div>
                        <h2 class="hidden-record-title">@summary.OwnerName</h2>
                        <p class="hidden-record-meta">
                            <span class="hidden-username">@summary.Username</span> ·
                            @summary.TableLabel ·
                            sat down @RestaurantClock.DateAndTime(summary.OpenedAt)
                            @if (summary.ClosedAt is { } closedAt)
                            {
                                <text> · settled @RestaurantClock.DateAndTime(closedAt)</text>
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                <text> · </text><strong>this sitting is still open</strong>
                            }
                        </p>
                        <p class="hidden-record-meta">
                            hidden @RestaurantClock.DateAndTimeWithSeconds(summary.HiddenAt)
                            by @summary.HiddenByName
                        </p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="hidden-record-money">
                        <span class="hidden-amount">@Money(summary.PersonTotalAmount)</span>
                        <span class="hidden-record-note">
                            their share of @Money(summary.SettledTotalAmount ?? 0m)
                        </span>
                        <span class="hidden-record-note">
                            @summary.LineCount @(summary.LineCount == 1 ? "line" : "lines")
                        </span>
                    </div>
                </header>

                <p class="hidden-record-actions">
                    @if (IsExpanded(summary))
                    {
                        <a href="@ListPath()">Close the record</a>
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <a href="@RecordPath(summary)">Open the complete record</a>
                    }
                    <span class="hidden-record-separator">·</span>
                    <a href="@SittingPath(summary)">The whole sitting</a>
                </p>

                @if (IsExpanded(summary))
                {
                    <h3 class="hidden-heading">The sitting</h3>

                    @if (_sitting is null)
                    {
                        <p class="hidden-muted">
                            The sitting behind this order could not be read. That should not be possible —
                            <code>guest_order.table_sitting_identifier</code> is a NOT NULL foreign key —
                            and is worth reporting.
                        </p>
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <dl class="hidden-facts">
                            <div>
                                <dt>Table</dt>
                                <dd>@_sitting.TableLabel</dd>
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <dt>Opened</dt>
                                <dd>@RestaurantClock.DateAndTime(_sitting.OpenedAt)</dd>
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <dt>Settled</dt>
                                <dd>
                                    @if (_sitting.ClosedAt is { } sittingClosedAt)
                                    {
                                        @RestaurantClock.DateAndTime(sittingClosedAt)
                                        @if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_sitting.ClosedByName))
                                        {
                                            <text> by @_sitting.ClosedByName</text>
                                        }
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        <text>still open</text>
                                    }
                                </dd>
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <dt>At the table</dt>
                                <dd>
                                    @_sitting.MemberCount
                                    @(_sitting.MemberCount == 1 ? "person" : "people") ·
                                    @_sitting.OrderCount @(_sitting.OrderCount == 1 ? "order" : "orders")
                                </dd>
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <dt>Settled total</dt>
                                <dd>
                                    @Money(_sitting.SettledTotalAmount ?? _sitting.CurrentTotalAmount)
                                    @if (_sitting.HasPostCloseCorrections)
                                    {
                                        <span class="hidden-corrected">
                                            corrected to @Money(_sitting.CurrentTotalAmount)
                                        </span>
                                    }
                                </dd>
                            </div>
                        </dl>
                    }

                    <h3 class="hidden-heading">Visibility log</h3>

                    @if (_visibilityLog.Count == 0)
                    {
                        <p class="hidden-muted">
                            No visibility events, which contradicts this order appearing on this page at
                            all — worth reporting.
                        </p>
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <ol class="hidden-events">
                            @foreach (OrderVisibilityEntry visibilityEvent in _visibilityLog)
                            {
                                <li>
                                    <span class="hidden-event-type">
                                        @DescribeVisibilityEvent(visibilityEvent.EventType)
                                    </span>
                                    <span class="hidden-muted-inline">
                                        @visibilityEvent.ActorName ·
                                        @RestaurantClock.DateAndTimeWithSeconds(visibilityEvent.OccurredAt)
                                    </span>
                                </li>
                            }
                        </ol>
                    }

                    <h3 class="hidden-heading">The record</h3>

                    @if (_record is null)
                    {
                        <p class="hidden-muted">
                            That order no longer exists. The row above came from a list read moments ago,
                            so this means it has been removed between the two reads — worth reporting,
                            because nothing in this system deletes an order.
                        </p>
                    }
                    else if (_record.Events.Count == 0)
                    {
                        <p class="hidden-muted">
                            The order row exists with no events on it. Only reachable if a write created it
                            and then rolled back its event, which the transaction does not do — worth
                            reporting if you are seeing it.
                        </p>
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <p class="hidden-muted">
                            Every event on this order, oldest first and complete —
                            @_record.Events.Count @(_record.Events.Count == 1 ? "event" : "events").
                            Removed lines, undone deliveries, and superseded prices are all still here,
                            because the history outliving the state is the point of the log (ADR-0002).
                        </p>

                        <ol class="hidden-events">
                            @foreach (StoredOrderEvent stored in _record.Events)
                            {
                                <li>
                                    <div class="hidden-event-head">
                                        <span class="hidden-event-sequence">#@stored.SequenceNumber</span>
                                        <span class="hidden-event-type">
                                            @DescribeEventType(stored.EventType)
                                        </span>
                                        <span class="hidden-muted-inline">
                                            @stored.ActorName as @DescribeActorRole(stored.ActorRole) ·
                                            @RestaurantClock.DateAndTimeWithSeconds(stored.OccurredAt)
                                        </span>
                                    </div>

                                    @if (stored.Operations.Count == 0)
                                    {
                                        <p class="hidden-muted">
                                            No operations recorded, which §6.5.1 forbids — worth reporting.
                                        </p>
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        <ul class="hidden-operations">
                                            @foreach (StoredOrderOperation operation in stored.Operations)
                                            {
                                                <li>@DescribeOperation(operation)</li>
                                            }
                                        </ul>
                                    }
                                </li>
                            }
                        </ol>
                    }

                    <div class="hidden-unhide">
                        <p>
                            <strong>Put this back on @summary.OwnerName's history?</strong>
                            An <code>unhidden</code> row is appended with your name and the time; the
                            <code>hidden</code> row stays where it is, so the log will show that it was
                            hidden and then restored rather than pretending neither happened.
                        </p>

                        <form method="post" @formname="unhide-order" @onsubmit="UnhideAsync">
                            <AntiforgeryToken />
                            <input type="hidden" name="@OrderField" value="@summary.GuestOrderIdentifier" />

                            <div class="form-actions">
                                <button type="submit" class="button-primary">Unhide this record</button>
                                <a class="button-secondary" href="@ListPath()">Leave it hidden</a>
                            </div>
                        </form>
                    </div>
                }
            </article>
        }
    }

    <p><a href="/administration">Back to people</a></p>
</section>

@code {
    private const int ListCap = 100;

    private const string DatePattern = "yyyy-MM-dd";

    private const string OrderField = "order";

    private IReadOnlyList<RestaurantTableSummary> _tables = [];
    private IReadOnlyList<HiddenOrderSummary>? _hidden;
    private HiddenOrderFilter _filter = HiddenOrderFilter.Everything;

    private SittingOrderRecord? _record;
    private CounterSittingSummary? _sitting;
    private IReadOnlyList<OrderVisibilityEntry> _visibilityLog = [];

    private string? _flashMessage;
    private string? _errorMessage;
    private string? _dateProblem;

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private string? Username { get; set; }

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private string? From { get; set; }

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private string? To { get; set; }

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private Guid? Table { get; set; }

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private Guid? Record { get; set; }

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private string? Done { get; set; }

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadAsync();

        if (HttpMethods.IsGet(HttpContext.Request.Method))
        {
            _flashMessage = FlashFor(Done);
        }
    }

    private async Task LoadAsync()
    {
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = HttpContext.RequestAborted;

        _tables = await Tables.ListTablesAsync(cancellationToken);
        _filter = BuildFilter();
        _hidden = await History.ListHiddenOrdersAsync(_filter, ListCap, cancellationToken);

        _record = null;
        _sitting = null;
        _visibilityLog = [];

        if (Record is not { } guestOrderIdentifier)
        {
            return;
        }

        HiddenOrderSummary? summary = _hidden
            .FirstOrDefault(candidate => candidate.GuestOrderIdentifier == guestOrderIdentifier);

        if (summary is null)
        {
            _errorMessage =
                "That record is not in the list below — it may have been unhidden already, or the filter " +
                "may exclude it. Clear the filter to look again.";
            return;
        }

        _record = await SittingRecords.GetOrderRecordAsync(guestOrderIdentifier, cancellationToken);
        _visibilityLog = await History.ListVisibilityLogAsync(guestOrderIdentifier, cancellationToken);
        _sitting = await CounterReads.GetSittingAsync(summary.SittingIdentifier, cancellationToken);
    }

    private HiddenOrderFilter BuildFilter()
    {
        DateOnly? from = ParseDate(From, "the earlier date");
        DateOnly? to = ParseDate(To, "the later date");

        if (from is { } lower && to is { } upper && upper < lower)
        {
            _dateProblem =
                "The later date is before the earlier one, so the range was ignored. Swap them, or clear " +
                "one of the two.";
            from = null;
            to = null;
        }

        return new HiddenOrderFilter(
            Username,
            from is { } start ? RestaurantClock.StartOfDay(start) : null,
            to is { } end ? RestaurantClock.StartOfNextDay(end) : null,
            Table);
    }

    private DateOnly? ParseDate(string? value, string which)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
        {
            return null;
        }

        if (DateOnly.TryParseExact(
                value.Trim(), DatePattern, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, DateTimeStyles.None,
                out DateOnly parsed))
        {
            return parsed;
        }

        _dateProblem = $"Could not read {which}, so it was ignored. Dates are year-month-day.";
        return null;
    }

    private async Task UnhideAsync()
    {
        if (PersonPrincipal.IdentifierFor(HttpContext.User) is not { } administrator)
        {
            _errorMessage = "Your session could not be identified. Sign in again and retry.";
            await LoadAsync();
            return;
        }

        IFormCollection form = await HttpContext.Request.ReadFormAsync(HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        string? postedOrder = form[OrderField];

        if (!Guid.TryParse(postedOrder, out Guid guestOrderIdentifier))
        {
            _errorMessage = "That request did not name a record, so nothing was unhidden.";
            await LoadAsync();
            return;
        }

        UnhideOrderResult result = await Visibility.UnhideAsync(
            guestOrderIdentifier, administrator, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        if (result.Outcome is UnhideOrderOutcome.Unhidden or UnhideOrderOutcome.NotHidden)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(ListPath(
                result.Outcome is UnhideOrderOutcome.Unhidden ? "unhidden" : "already-visible"));
            return;
        }

        _errorMessage =
            "That order no longer exists, so there was nothing to unhide. Reload the page to see the " +
            "current list.";
        await LoadAsync();
    }

    private bool IsExpanded(HiddenOrderSummary summary)
        => Record == summary.GuestOrderIdentifier;

    private string CountSentence(int count)
    {
        string noun = count == 1 ? "hidden order" : "hidden orders";
        string scope = _filter.IsNarrowed ? "matching the filter" : "in total";

        return count == ListCap
            ? $"{count} {noun} {scope} — capped at {ListCap}; narrow the filter to see past it."
            : $"{count} {noun} {scope}.";
    }

    private string ListPath(string? done = null)
    {
        List<string> parts = [];

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Username))
        {
            parts.Add($"username={Uri.EscapeDataString(Username.Trim())}");
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(From))
        {
            parts.Add($"from={Uri.EscapeDataString(From.Trim())}");
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(To))
        {
            parts.Add($"to={Uri.EscapeDataString(To.Trim())}");
        }

        if (Table is { } tableIdentifier)
        {
            parts.Add($"table={tableIdentifier}");
        }

        if (done is not null)
        {
            parts.Add($"done={done}");
        }

        return parts.Count == 0
            ? "/administration/hidden-records"
            : $"/administration/hidden-records?{string.Join("&", parts)}";
    }

    private string RecordPath(HiddenOrderSummary summary)
    {
        string list = ListPath();
        string separator = list.Contains('?', StringComparison.Ordinal) ? "&" : "?";

        return $"{list}{separator}record={summary.GuestOrderIdentifier}";
    }

    private static string SittingPath(HiddenOrderSummary summary)
        => $"/administration/sittings/{summary.SittingIdentifier}";

    private static string? FlashFor(string? done) => done switch
    {
        "unhidden" =>
            "Unhidden. It is back on its owner's history page, and the visibility log records that you " +
            "put it there.",
        "already-visible" =>
            "It was not hidden any more — another administrator had already unhidden it, so nothing was " +
            "appended.",
        _ => null,
    };

    private static string DescribeVisibilityEvent(string eventType) => eventType switch
    {
        "hidden" => "Hidden by the owner",
        "unhidden" => "Restored by an administrator",
        _ => eventType,
    };

    private static string DescribeEventType(string eventType) => eventType switch
    {
        "guest_submission" => "Guest send",
        "staff_edit" => "Staff edit",
        "price_adjustment" => "Price change",
        "fulfillment" => "Delivered",
        "fulfillment_reversal" => "Delivery undone",
        _ => eventType,
    };

    private static string DescribeActorRole(string actorRole) => actorRole switch
    {
        "guest" => "a guest",
        "kitchen" => "the kitchen",
        "counter" => "the counter",
        "administrator" => "an administrator",
        _ => actorRole,
    };

    private string DescribeOperation(StoredOrderOperation operation) => operation.OperationKind switch
    {
        "line_added" =>
            $"Added {operation.Quantity} × {operation.MenuItemName} at " +
            $"{Money(operation.UnitPriceAmount ?? 0m)} each{NoteSuffix(operation.CustomizationNote)}",
        "line_removed" =>
            $"Removed {operation.Quantity} × {operation.MenuItemName}{ReasonSuffix(operation.Reason)}",
        "line_price_adjusted" =>
            $"{operation.Quantity} × {operation.MenuItemName} repriced to " +
            $"{Money(operation.NewUnitPriceAmount ?? 0m)} each{ReasonSuffix(operation.Reason)}",
        "line_fulfilled" =>
            $"{operation.Quantity} × {operation.MenuItemName} delivered",
        "line_fulfillment_reverted" =>
            $"{operation.Quantity} × {operation.MenuItemName} put back with the kitchen",
        _ => $"{operation.OperationKind} on {operation.Quantity} × {operation.MenuItemName}",
    };

    private static string NoteSuffix(string? note)
        => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(note) ? string.Empty : $" — “{note.Trim()}”";

    private static string ReasonSuffix(string? reason)
        => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(reason) ? string.Empty : $" — {reason.Trim()}";

    private string Money(decimal amount) => MoneyText.Format(amount, Options.CurrencyCode);
}

            <InputText id="rename-name" @bind-Value="RenameInput.Name" autocomplete="off" />

            <ValidationMessage For="@(() => RenameInput.Name)" />
        </EditForm>

        <hr class="manage-rule" />

        <h2 class="manage-heading">Price</h2>
        <p class="lede">
            A new price applies to lines added <strong>from now on</strong>. Anything already on an order
            keeps the price it was added at, including on open tables — that is the capture rule (§6.5.4),
            and it is why a guest who ordered before the change is not surprised at the till.
        </p>
        <EditForm Model="RepriceInput" method="post" OnValidSubmit="RepriceAsync" FormName="menu-item-reprice" class="manage-inline-form">
            <DataAnnotationsValidator />
            <label class="visually-hidden" for="reprice-price">New price</label>
            <span class="manage-currency">@Options.CurrencyCode</span>
            <InputNumber id="reprice-price" @bind-Value="RepriceInput.PriceAmount" step="0.01" min="0" inputmode="decimal" />
            <button type="submit" class="button-primary">Reprice</button>
            <ValidationMessage For="@(() => RepriceInput.PriceAmount)" />
        </EditForm>

        <hr class="manage-rule" />

        <h2 class="manage-heading">Description</h2>
        <p class="lede">
            One or two sentences a guest reads before ordering. Optional — clearing the box is an ordinary
            change with an ordinary entry in the history below, not a deletion. Saving the same text again
            records nothing.
        </p>

        <EditForm Model="DescribeInput" method="post" OnValidSubmit="DescribeAsync" FormName="menu-item-describe">
            <DataAnnotationsValidator />
            <div class="form-field">
                <label class="visually-hidden" for="describe-description">Description</label>
                <InputTextArea id="describe-description" @bind-Value="DescribeInput.Description" rows="3" autocomplete="off" />
                <ValidationMessage For="@(() => DescribeInput.Description)" />
            </div>
            <div class="form-actions">
                <button type="submit" class="button-primary">Save description</button>
            </div>
        </EditForm>

        <hr class="manage-rule" />

        <h2 class="manage-heading">Picture</h2>
        <p class="lede">
            One photograph of the dish. It is stored in this restaurant's own database and served by this
            application, so nothing about the menu leaves the building. The formats it stores are
            @MenuItemImageUpload.RecognisedTypesForOperators — and <strong>what a file is decides
            that, rather than what it is called</strong>, so a picture saved without an extension is
            perfectly acceptable and anything that is not a picture is refused with a reason.
            <strong>The size limit belongs to the database rather than to this page</strong>, and a
            photograph straight off a phone camera is usually several times over it — this browser will
            resize a copy to fit before it is sent, and say below what it did. The file on this device is
            never altered. Attaching a second picture replaces the first: the old one is deleted and its
            address stops working, which is exactly why a browser is told it may keep a picture for a
            year.
        </p>

        @if (_picture is not null)
        {
            <figure class="manage-picture">

                <img class="manage-picture-image"
                     src="@MenuImageRoutes.ForImage(_picture.MenuItemImageIdentifier)"
                     alt="" />
                <figcaption class="manage-picture-facts">
                    @_picture.ContentType · @_picture.ByteLength bytes · attached
                    @RestaurantClock.DateAndTime(_picture.UploadedAt)
                </figcaption>
            </figure>
        }
        else
        {
            <p class="lede muted">No picture. Guests see the name, the price and the description only.</p>
        }

        <form method="post" enctype="multipart/form-data" @formname="menu-item-image-attach" @onsubmit="AttachPictureAsync" class="manage-inline-form">
            <AntiforgeryToken />
            <label class="visually-hidden" for="picture-file">Picture file</label>

            <input type="file" id="picture-file" name="@MenuItemImageUpload.FileFieldName" accept="@MenuItemImageUpload.AcceptAttribute"
                   aria-describedby="@MenuItemImageUpload.StatusElementId" @attributes="PictureBudgetAttributes" />
            <button type="submit" class="button-primary">@(_picture is null ? "Attach picture" : "Replace picture")</button>
        </form>

        <p id="@MenuItemImageUpload.StatusElementId" class="lede muted" role="status" hidden></p>

        @if (_picture is not null)
        {
            <form method="post" @formname="menu-item-image-remove" @onsubmit="RemovePictureAsync" class="manage-inline-form">
                <AntiforgeryToken />
                <button type="submit" class="button-secondary">Remove picture</button>
            </form>

            <p class="lede">
                <strong>What a screen reader says instead of the picture.</strong> Leave it empty unless the
                photograph shows something the dish's name does not — the guest's menu already reads out the
                name and the price beside it, so a caption repeating the name would have somebody hear the
                dish twice. <em>“Served on a bed of wilted greens with a lemon wedge”</em> is the kind of
                thing worth writing. Changing it does <strong>not</strong> re-upload the photograph and does
                not change its address, and replacing the photograph later keeps whatever is written here.
            </p>

            <EditForm method="post" Model="AltTextInput" OnValidSubmit="SetPictureAltTextAsync"
                      FormName="menu-item-image-alt-text" class="manage-inline-form">
                <DataAnnotationsValidator />
                <label class="visually-hidden" for="picture-alt-text">What a screen reader says</label>
                <InputText id="picture-alt-text" @bind-Value="AltTextInput.AltText"
                           maxlength="500" autocomplete="off"
                           placeholder="Leave empty unless it says more than the name" />
                <button type="submit" class="button-primary">Save caption</button>

                <ValidationMessage For="@(() => AltTextInput.AltText)" />
            </EditForm>
        }

        <h3 class="manage-subheading">Picture history</h3>
        @if (_pictureHistory is null || _pictureHistory.Count == 0)
        {
            <p class="lede muted">
                No picture has ever been attached to this item. Once one is, every attach, replacement,
                caption change and removal is recorded here.
            </p>
        }
        else
        {
            <p class="lede">
                Every change to this item's picture, oldest first — @_pictureHistory.Count
                @(_pictureHistory.Count == 1 ? "entry" : "entries"), complete and untruncated. A
                replacement and a removal each delete the photograph itself; this record of it stays.
            </p>
            <div class="record-list">
                <table>
                    <thead>
                        <tr>
                            <th scope="col">When</th>
                            <th scope="col">Change</th>
                            <th scope="col">By</th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                        @foreach (MenuItemImageEventEntry entry in _pictureHistory)
                        {
                            <tr>
                                <td data-label="When">@RestaurantClock.DateAndTime(entry.OccurredAt)</td>
                                <td class="record-primary" data-label="Change">@DescribePicture(entry)</td>
                                <td data-label="By">@entry.ActorName</td>
                            </tr>
                        }
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        }

        <hr class="manage-rule" />

        <h2 class="manage-heading">Section</h2>
        <p class="lede">
            The heading this item is filed under. Moving it puts it at the <strong>end</strong> of the
            heading you choose, on the same rule a newly created item follows — a position belongs to the
            heading it is a position within, so carrying the old number across would drop this item into
            the middle of somebody else's ordering. Set the position below afterwards if the end is not
            where it belongs. Nothing else about the item changes: an item marked unavailable stays
            unavailable under its new heading.
        </p>
        @if (_sections.Count > 0)
        {
            <EditForm Model="MoveInput" method="post" OnValidSubmit="MoveAsync" FormName="menu-item-move-section" class="manage-inline-form">
                <DataAnnotationsValidator />
                <label class="visually-hidden" for="move-section">New section</label>

                <InputSelect id="move-section" @bind-Value="MoveInput.MenuSectionIdentifier">
                    @foreach (MenuSectionSummary heading in _sections)
                    {
                        <option value="@heading.MenuSectionIdentifier">
                            @(heading.IsActive
                                ? heading.Name
                                : $"{heading.Name} (hidden from guests)")
                        </option>
                    }
                </InputSelect>
                <button type="submit" class="button-primary">File here</button>
            </EditForm>
        }

        <hr class="manage-rule" />

        <h2 class="manage-heading">Position</h2>
        <p class="lede">
            Where this item sits <strong>within its section</strong>. Lower comes first; items sharing a
            position are ordered by name, which is why a heading reads alphabetically until somebody
            decides otherwise. Positions do not have to be unique or contiguous, and they are counted per
            heading — so two items in two sections may both sit at 0.
        </p>
        <EditForm Model="ReorderInput" method="post" OnValidSubmit="ReorderAsync" FormName="menu-item-reorder" class="manage-inline-form">
            <DataAnnotationsValidator />
            <label class="visually-hidden" for="reorder-position">New position</label>
            <InputNumber id="reorder-position" @bind-Value="ReorderInput.DisplayOrder" step="1" min="0" inputmode="numeric" />
            <button type="submit" class="button-primary">Move</button>
            <ValidationMessage For="@(() => ReorderInput.DisplayOrder)" />
        </EditForm>

        <hr class="manage-rule" />

        <h2 class="manage-heading">Availability</h2>
        @if (_item.IsActive)
        {
            <p class="lede">
                Marking this unavailable is the "86". It stays on the guest's menu, labelled unavailable,
                and cannot be added to a send; nothing is hidden and nothing is deleted. The kitchen and
                the counter can do this too, from their own screens.
            </p>
            <form method="post" @formname="menu-item-set-active" @onsubmit="ToggleAvailabilityAsync">
                <AntiforgeryToken />
                <div class="form-actions">
                    <button type="submit" class="button-secondary">Mark unavailable</button>
                </div>
            </form>
        }
        else
        {
            <p class="lede">
                This item is on the menu marked unavailable and cannot be ordered. Bring it back when it
                is on again.
            </p>
            <form method="post" @formname="menu-item-set-active" @onsubmit="ToggleAvailabilityAsync">
                <AntiforgeryToken />
                <div class="form-actions">
                    <button type="submit" class="button-primary">Mark available</button>
                </div>
            </form>
        }

        <hr class="manage-rule" />

        <h2 class="manage-heading">History</h2>
        @if (_history is null || _history.Count == 0)
        {
            <p class="lede">No recorded changes. That is only possible for an item created before this log existed.</p>
        }
        else
        {
            <p class="lede">
                Everything that has ever happened to this item, oldest first — @_history.Count
                @(_history.Count == 1 ? "entry" : "entries"), complete and untruncated.
            </p>

            <div class="record-list">
                <table>
                    <thead>
                        <tr>
                            <th scope="col">When</th>
                            <th scope="col">Change</th>
                            <th scope="col">By</th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                        @foreach (MenuItemEventEntry entry in _history)
                        {
                            <tr>
                                <td data-label="When">@RestaurantClock.DateAndTime(entry.OccurredAt)</td>
                                <td class="record-primary" data-label="Change">@Describe(entry)</td>
                                <td data-label="By">@entry.ActorName</td>
                            </tr>
                        }
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        }

        <p class="manage-back"><a href="/administration/menu">Back to the menu</a></p>
    </section>
}

@code {
    private MenuItemSummary? _item;
    private IReadOnlyList<MenuSectionSummary> _sections = [];
    private IReadOnlyList<MenuItemEventEntry>? _history;
    private MenuItemImageMetadata? _picture;

    private IReadOnlyList<MenuItemImageEventEntry>? _pictureHistory;

    private int? _pictureByteCap;

    private string? _flashMessage;
    private string? _errorMessage;

    [Parameter]
    public Guid MenuItemId { get; set; }

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "menu-item-rename")]
    private RenameInputModel RenameInput { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "menu-item-reprice")]
    private RepriceInputModel RepriceInput { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "menu-item-describe")]
    private DescribeInputModel DescribeInput { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "menu-item-move-section")]
    private MoveInputModel MoveInput { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "menu-item-reorder")]
    private ReorderInputModel ReorderInput { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "menu-item-image-alt-text")]
    private AltTextInputModel AltTextInput { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private string? Done { get; set; }

    private string ManagePath => $"/administration/menu/{MenuItemId}";

    private IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object> PictureBudgetAttributes
        => _pictureByteCap is { } cap
            ? new Dictionary<string, object>(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            {
                [MenuItemImageUpload.ByteBudgetAttributeName] = cap,
                [MenuItemImageUpload.LongestEdgeAttributeName] = MenuItemImageUpload.LongestEdgePixels,
            }
            : new Dictionary<string, object>(StringComparer.Ordinal);

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        RenameInput ??= new();
        RepriceInput ??= new();
        DescribeInput ??= new();
        MoveInput ??= new();
        ReorderInput ??= new();
        AltTextInput ??= new();

        _item = await MenuItems.GetAsync(MenuItemId, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        if (_item is null)
        {
            return;
        }

        _sections = await MenuSections.ListAsync(HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        _history = await MenuEvents.ListForItemAsync(MenuItemId, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        _picture = await MenuItemPictures.FindForItemAsync(MenuItemId, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        _pictureHistory = await MenuItemPictureEvents.ListForItemAsync(
            MenuItemId, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        _pictureByteCap = await MenuItemPictures.ReadDeclaredByteCapAsync(HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        if (HttpMethods.IsGet(HttpContext.Request.Method))
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(RenameInput.Name))
            {
                RenameInput.Name = _item.Name;
            }

            RepriceInput.PriceAmount = _item.PriceAmount;

            DescribeInput.Description = _item.Description;
            ReorderInput.DisplayOrder = _item.DisplayOrder;

            MoveInput.MenuSectionIdentifier = _item.MenuSectionIdentifier;

            AltTextInput.AltText = _picture?.AltText ?? string.Empty;

            _flashMessage = FlashFor(Done);
        }
    }

    private async Task RenameAsync()
    {
        if (!TryBegin(out Guid administrator))
        {
            return;
        }

        RenameMenuItemResult result = await MenuChanges.RenameMenuItemAsync(
            MenuItemId, RenameInput.Name.Trim(), administrator, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        switch (result.Outcome)
        {
            case RenameMenuItemOutcome.Renamed:
                RedirectWithOutcome("renamed");
                break;
            case RenameMenuItemOutcome.NoChange:
                RedirectWithOutcome("rename-no-change");
                break;
            case RenameMenuItemOutcome.MenuItemNotFound:
                Navigation.NavigateTo("/administration/menu");
                break;
        }
    }

    private async Task RepriceAsync()
    {
        if (!TryBegin(out Guid administrator))
        {
            return;
        }

        RepriceMenuItemResult result = await MenuChanges.RepriceMenuItemAsync(
            MenuItemId, RepriceInput.PriceAmount, administrator, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        switch (result.Outcome)
        {
            case RepriceMenuItemOutcome.Repriced:
                RedirectWithOutcome("repriced");
                break;
            case RepriceMenuItemOutcome.NoChange:
                RedirectWithOutcome("reprice-no-change");
                break;
            case RepriceMenuItemOutcome.MenuItemNotFound:
                Navigation.NavigateTo("/administration/menu");
                break;
        }
    }

    private async Task DescribeAsync()
    {
        if (!TryBegin(out Guid administrator))
        {
            return;
        }

        DescribeMenuItemOutcome outcome = await MenuChanges.DescribeMenuItemAsync(
            MenuItemId, DescribeInput.Description, administrator, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        switch (outcome)
        {
            case DescribeMenuItemOutcome.Described:
                RedirectWithOutcome(
                    DescribeInput.Description.Trim().Length == 0 ? "description-cleared" : "described");
                break;
            case DescribeMenuItemOutcome.NoChange:
                RedirectWithOutcome("describe-no-change");
                break;
            case DescribeMenuItemOutcome.MenuItemNotFound:
                Navigation.NavigateTo("/administration/menu");
                break;
        }
    }

    private async Task MoveAsync()
    {
        if (!TryBegin(out Guid administrator))
        {
            return;
        }

        MoveMenuItemToSectionOutcome outcome = await MenuChanges.MoveMenuItemToSectionAsync(
            MenuItemId, MoveInput.MenuSectionIdentifier, administrator, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        switch (outcome)
        {
            case MoveMenuItemToSectionOutcome.Moved:
                RedirectWithOutcome("refiled");
                break;
            case MoveMenuItemToSectionOutcome.NoChange:
                RedirectWithOutcome("refile-no-change");
                break;
            case MoveMenuItemToSectionOutcome.MenuSectionNotFound:

                _errorMessage =
                    "That section no longer exists. It may have been changed while this page was open —"
                    + " reload the page and choose again.";
                break;
            case MoveMenuItemToSectionOutcome.MenuItemNotFound:
                Navigation.NavigateTo("/administration/menu");
                break;
        }
    }

    private async Task ReorderAsync()
    {
        if (!TryBegin(out Guid administrator))
        {
            return;
        }

        ReorderMenuItemOutcome outcome = await MenuChanges.ReorderMenuItemAsync(
            MenuItemId, ReorderInput.DisplayOrder, administrator, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        switch (outcome)
        {
            case ReorderMenuItemOutcome.Reordered:
                RedirectWithOutcome("moved");
                break;
            case ReorderMenuItemOutcome.NoChange:
                RedirectWithOutcome("move-no-change");
                break;
            case ReorderMenuItemOutcome.MenuItemNotFound:
                Navigation.NavigateTo("/administration/menu");
                break;
        }
    }

    private async Task ToggleAvailabilityAsync()
    {
        if (_item is null || !TryBegin(out Guid administrator))
        {
            return;
        }

        bool target = !_item.IsActive;
        SetMenuItemAvailabilityResult result = await MenuChanges.SetMenuItemActiveAsync(
            MenuItemId, target, administrator, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        switch (result.Outcome)
        {
            case SetMenuItemAvailabilityOutcome.Changed:
                RedirectWithOutcome(target ? "made-available" : "made-unavailable");
                break;
            case SetMenuItemAvailabilityOutcome.AlreadyInThatState:

                Navigation.NavigateTo(ManagePath);
                break;
            case SetMenuItemAvailabilityOutcome.MenuItemNotFound:
                Navigation.NavigateTo("/administration/menu");
                break;
        }
    }

    private async Task AttachPictureAsync()
    {
        if (!TryBegin(out Guid administrator))
        {
            return;
        }

        IFormFile? file = HttpContext.Request.Form.Files[MenuItemImageUpload.FileFieldName];

        byte[] bytes = [];
        if (file is not null)
        {
            using MemoryStream buffer = new();
            using Stream content = file.OpenReadStream();
            await content.CopyToAsync(buffer, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
            bytes = buffer.ToArray();
        }

        string identified = ImageFormat.IdentifyContentType(bytes) ?? string.Empty;

        AttachMenuItemImageResult result = await MenuChanges.AttachMenuItemImageAsync(
            IdentifierFactory.Create(),
            MenuItemId,
            identified,
            bytes,
            administrator,
            HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        switch (result.Outcome)
        {
            case AttachMenuItemImageOutcome.Attached:
                RedirectWithOutcome("picture-attached");
                break;
            case AttachMenuItemImageOutcome.Replaced:
                RedirectWithOutcome("picture-replaced");
                break;
            case AttachMenuItemImageOutcome.BytesEmpty:

                _errorMessage = "No file was chosen, or the file was empty. Nothing changed.";
                break;
            case AttachMenuItemImageOutcome.UnsupportedContentType:

                _errorMessage =
                    "That file is not a picture in any format this menu stores ("
                    + MenuItemImageUpload.RecognisedTypesForOperators
                    + "). This was decided by reading the file itself rather than its name, so renaming"
                    + " it will not help. Nothing changed.";
                break;
            case AttachMenuItemImageOutcome.ContentTypeContradictedByBytes:

                _errorMessage =
                    "That file was refused because its contents and its declared format disagree."
                    + " Nothing changed.";
                break;
            case AttachMenuItemImageOutcome.BytesOverCap:
                _errorMessage =
                    "That picture is larger than this menu will store. A photograph taken on a phone is"
                    + " usually several times the limit — export or resize it smaller and try again."
                    + " Nothing changed.";
                break;
            case AttachMenuItemImageOutcome.MenuItemNotFound:
                Navigation.NavigateTo("/administration/menu");
                break;
        }
    }

    private async Task RemovePictureAsync()
    {
        if (!TryBegin(out Guid administrator))
        {
            return;
        }

        RemoveMenuItemImageOutcome outcome = await MenuChanges.RemoveMenuItemImageAsync(
            MenuItemId, administrator, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        switch (outcome)
        {
            case RemoveMenuItemImageOutcome.Removed:
                RedirectWithOutcome("picture-removed");
                break;
            case RemoveMenuItemImageOutcome.NoImage:

                Navigation.NavigateTo(ManagePath);
                break;
            case RemoveMenuItemImageOutcome.MenuItemNotFound:
                Navigation.NavigateTo("/administration/menu");
                break;
        }
    }

    private async Task SetPictureAltTextAsync()
    {
        if (!TryBegin(out Guid administrator))
        {
            return;
        }

        SetMenuItemImageAltTextOutcome outcome = await MenuChanges.SetMenuItemImageAltTextAsync(
            MenuItemId,
            AltTextInput.AltText.Trim(),
            administrator,
            HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        switch (outcome)
        {
            case SetMenuItemImageAltTextOutcome.Changed:
                RedirectWithOutcome(
                    AltTextInput.AltText.Trim().Length == 0 ? "caption-cleared" : "caption-saved");
                break;
            case SetMenuItemImageAltTextOutcome.NoChange:
                RedirectWithOutcome("caption-no-change");
                break;
            case SetMenuItemImageAltTextOutcome.NoImage:
                _errorMessage =
                    "There is no picture on this item any more, so there is nothing for a caption to"
                    + " describe. Somebody may have removed it while this page was open. Nothing changed.";
                break;
            case SetMenuItemImageAltTextOutcome.MenuItemNotFound:
                Navigation.NavigateTo("/administration/menu");
                break;
        }
    }

    private bool TryBegin(out Guid administrator)
    {
        administrator = Guid.Empty;

        if (_item is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo("/administration/menu");
            return false;
        }

        if (PersonPrincipal.IdentifierFor(HttpContext.User) is not { } identifier)
        {
            _errorMessage = "Your session could not be identified. Sign in again and retry.";
            return false;
        }

        administrator = identifier;
        return true;
    }

    private void RedirectWithOutcome(string outcome)
        => Navigation.NavigateTo($"{ManagePath}?done={outcome}");

    private static string? FlashFor(string? outcome) => outcome switch
    {
        "renamed" => "Renamed. The new name shows everywhere immediately, including on past orders.",
        "rename-no-change" => "That was already the name — nothing changed.",
        "repriced" => "Repriced. Lines already on an order keep the price they were added at.",
        "reprice-no-change" => "That was already the price — nothing changed.",
        "described" => "Description saved. Guests reading the menu see it from now on.",
        "description-cleared" => "Description cleared. Guests see the name and the price only.",
        "describe-no-change" => "That was already the description — nothing changed.",
        "refiled" => "Filed under its new heading, at the end of it. Every open menu has already"
            + " regrouped; set the position below if the end is not where it belongs.",
        "refile-no-change" => "It was already under that heading — nothing changed.",
        "moved" => "Moved. The menu is ordered by position, then by name.",
        "move-no-change" => "It was already in that position — nothing changed.",
        "made-unavailable" => "Marked unavailable. It stays on the guest's menu, labelled unavailable, and cannot be ordered.",
        "made-available" => "Marked available. It can be ordered again.",
        "picture-attached" => "Picture attached.",
        "picture-replaced" => "Picture replaced. The old one is deleted and its address no longer works,"
            + " which is why a browser may safely keep the new one for a year.",

        "picture-removed" => "Picture removed. The record of it stays in the picture history above.",
        "caption-saved" => "Caption saved. Guests using a screen reader hear it instead of the picture,"
            + " and every open menu has already picked it up.",
        "caption-cleared" => "Caption cleared. A screen reader will skip the picture, which is the right"
            + " outcome unless the photograph shows something the dish's name does not.",
        "caption-no-change" => "That was already the caption — nothing changed.",
        _ => null,
    };

    private string Money(decimal amount) => MoneyText.Format(amount, Options.CurrencyCode);

    private string Describe(MenuItemEventEntry entry) => entry.EventType switch
    {
        "created" => $"Created as “{entry.NewName}” at {Money(entry.NewPriceAmount ?? 0m)}",
        "name_changed" => $"Renamed to “{entry.NewName}”",
        "price_changed" => $"Repriced to {Money(entry.NewPriceAmount ?? 0m)}",
        "description_changed" => (entry.NewDescription ?? string.Empty).Length == 0
            ? "Description cleared"
            : $"Description set to “{entry.NewDescription}”",
        "section_changed" => $"Filed under “{entry.NewMenuSectionName}”",
        "reordered" => $"Moved to position {entry.NewDisplayOrder}",
        "activated" => "Marked available",
        "deactivated" => "Marked unavailable",
        _ => entry.EventType,
    };

    private string DescribePicture(MenuItemImageEventEntry entry) => entry.EventType switch
    {
        "attached" => $"Picture attached — {entry.NewContentType}, {entry.NewByteLength} bytes",
        "replaced" => $"Replaced with a new picture — {entry.NewContentType}, {entry.NewByteLength} bytes",
        "removed" => "Picture removed",
        "alt_text_changed" => (entry.NewAltText ?? string.Empty).Length == 0
            ? "Caption cleared — a screen reader now skips the picture"
            : $"Caption set to “{entry.NewAltText}”",
        _ => entry.EventType,
    };

    private sealed class RenameInputModel
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Enter a name.")]
        [StringLength(120, MinimumLength = 1, ErrorMessage = "The name must be 1–120 characters.")]
        public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }

    private sealed class RepriceInputModel
    {
        [Range(0, 99999999.99, ErrorMessage = "The price must be between 0 and 99,999,999.99.")]
        public decimal PriceAmount { get; set; }
    }

    private sealed class DescribeInputModel
    {
        [StringLength(2000, ErrorMessage = "The description must be 2,000 characters or fewer.")]
        public string Description { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }

    private sealed class MoveInputModel
    {
        public Guid MenuSectionIdentifier { get; set; }
    }

    private sealed class ReorderInputModel
    {
        [Range(0, 2147483647, ErrorMessage = "The position must be 0 or greater.")]
        public int DisplayOrder { get; set; }
    }

    private sealed class AltTextInputModel
    {
        [StringLength(500, ErrorMessage = "The caption must be 500 characters or fewer.")]
        public string AltText { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }
}

@code {
    private MenuSectionSummary? _section;
    private IReadOnlyList<MenuItemSummary> _items = [];
    private IReadOnlyList<MenuSectionEventEntry>? _history;
    private int _itemCount;
    private string? _flashMessage;
    private string? _errorMessage;

    [Parameter]
    public Guid MenuSectionId { get; set; }

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "menu-section-rename")]
    private RenameInputModel RenameInput { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "menu-section-describe")]
    private DescribeInputModel DescribeInput { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "menu-section-reorder")]
    private ReorderInputModel ReorderInput { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private string? Done { get; set; }

    private string ManagePath => $"/administration/menu/sections/{MenuSectionId}";

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        RenameInput ??= new();
        DescribeInput ??= new();
        ReorderInput ??= new();

        _section = await MenuSections.GetAsync(MenuSectionId, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        if (_section is null)
        {
            return;
        }

        IReadOnlyList<MenuItemSummary> everything = await MenuItems.ListAsync(HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        _items = everything.Where(item => item.MenuSectionIdentifier == MenuSectionId).ToArray();
        _itemCount = _items.Count;

        _history = await MenuSectionEvents.ListForSectionAsync(MenuSectionId, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        if (HttpMethods.IsGet(HttpContext.Request.Method))
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(RenameInput.Name))
            {
                RenameInput.Name = _section.Name;
            }

            DescribeInput.Description = _section.Description;
            ReorderInput.DisplayOrder = _section.DisplayOrder;

            _flashMessage = FlashFor(Done);
        }
    }

    private async Task RenameAsync()
    {
        if (!TryBegin(out Guid administrator))
        {
            return;
        }

        RenameMenuSectionOutcome outcome = await MenuChanges.RenameMenuSectionAsync(
            MenuSectionId, RenameInput.Name.Trim(), administrator, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        switch (outcome)
        {
            case RenameMenuSectionOutcome.Renamed:
                RedirectWithOutcome("renamed");
                break;
            case RenameMenuSectionOutcome.NoChange:
                RedirectWithOutcome("rename-no-change");
                break;
            case RenameMenuSectionOutcome.NameTaken:

                _errorMessage =
                    "Another section already uses that name. Section names ignore capitalisation, so"
                    + " check the menu for one spelled differently.";
                break;
            case RenameMenuSectionOutcome.MenuSectionNotFound:
                Navigation.NavigateTo("/administration/menu");
                break;
        }
    }

    private async Task DescribeAsync()
    {
        if (!TryBegin(out Guid administrator))
        {
            return;
        }

        DescribeMenuSectionOutcome outcome = await MenuChanges.DescribeMenuSectionAsync(
            MenuSectionId, DescribeInput.Description, administrator, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        switch (outcome)
        {
            case DescribeMenuSectionOutcome.Described:
                RedirectWithOutcome(
                    DescribeInput.Description.Trim().Length == 0 ? "description-cleared" : "described");
                break;
            case DescribeMenuSectionOutcome.NoChange:
                RedirectWithOutcome("describe-no-change");
                break;
            case DescribeMenuSectionOutcome.MenuSectionNotFound:
                Navigation.NavigateTo("/administration/menu");
                break;
        }
    }

    private async Task ReorderAsync()
    {
        if (!TryBegin(out Guid administrator))
        {
            return;
        }

        ReorderMenuSectionOutcome outcome = await MenuChanges.ReorderMenuSectionAsync(
            MenuSectionId, ReorderInput.DisplayOrder, administrator, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        switch (outcome)
        {
            case ReorderMenuSectionOutcome.Reordered:
                RedirectWithOutcome("moved");
                break;
            case ReorderMenuSectionOutcome.NoChange:
                RedirectWithOutcome("move-no-change");
                break;
            case ReorderMenuSectionOutcome.MenuSectionNotFound:
                Navigation.NavigateTo("/administration/menu");
                break;
        }
    }

    private async Task ToggleVisibilityAsync()
    {
        if (_section is null || !TryBegin(out Guid administrator))
        {
            return;
        }

        bool target = !_section.IsActive;
        MenuSectionActivationOutcome outcome = await MenuChanges.SetMenuSectionActiveAsync(
            MenuSectionId, target, administrator, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        switch (outcome)
        {
            case MenuSectionActivationOutcome.Changed:
                RedirectWithOutcome(target ? "shown" : "hidden");
                break;
            case MenuSectionActivationOutcome.NoChange:

                Navigation.NavigateTo(ManagePath);
                break;
            case MenuSectionActivationOutcome.MenuSectionNotFound:
                Navigation.NavigateTo("/administration/menu");
                break;
        }
    }

    private bool TryBegin(out Guid administrator)
    {
        administrator = Guid.Empty;

        if (_section is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo("/administration/menu");
            return false;
        }

        if (PersonPrincipal.IdentifierFor(HttpContext.User) is not { } identifier)
        {
            _errorMessage = "Your session could not be identified. Sign in again and retry.";
            return false;
        }

        administrator = identifier;
        return true;
    }

    private void RedirectWithOutcome(string outcome)
        => Navigation.NavigateTo($"{ManagePath}?done={outcome}");

    private static string? FlashFor(string? outcome) => outcome switch
    {
        "renamed" => "Renamed. Every open menu has already picked up the new heading.",
        "rename-no-change" => "That was already the name — nothing changed.",
        "described" => "Description saved.",
        "description-cleared" => "Description cleared. The heading stands on its own.",
        "describe-no-change" => "That was already the description — nothing changed.",
        "moved" => "Moved. The menu is ordered by position, then by name.",
        "move-no-change" => "It was already in that position — nothing changed.",
        "hidden" => "Hidden from guests. This heading and everything under it have left every open menu;"
            + " the items themselves are untouched.",
        "shown" => "Showing to guests again, with every item exactly as it was.",
        _ => null,
    };

    private static string Describe(MenuSectionEventEntry entry) => entry.EventType switch
    {
        "created" => $"Created as “{entry.NewName}” at position {entry.NewDisplayOrder}",
        "renamed" => $"Renamed to “{entry.NewName}”",
        "described" => (entry.NewDescription ?? string.Empty).Length == 0
            ? "Description cleared"
            : $"Description set to “{entry.NewDescription}”",
        "reordered" => $"Moved to position {entry.NewDisplayOrder}",
        "activated" => "Shown to guests",
        "deactivated" => "Hidden from guests",
        _ => entry.EventType,
    };

    private sealed class RenameInputModel
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Give the section a name.")]
        [StringLength(80, MinimumLength = 1, ErrorMessage = "The name must be 1–80 characters.")]
        public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }

    private sealed class DescribeInputModel
    {
        [StringLength(2000, ErrorMessage = "The description must be 2,000 characters or fewer.")]
        public string Description { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }

    private sealed class ReorderInputModel
    {
        [Range(0, 2147483647, ErrorMessage = "The position must be 0 or greater.")]
        public int DisplayOrder { get; set; }
    }
}

                <AntiforgeryToken />
                <div class="form-actions">
                    <button type="submit" class="link-button danger">Deactivate account</button>
                </div>
            </form>
        }
        else
        {
            <p class="lede">This account is deactivated and cannot sign in. Reactivate it to restore access.</p>
            <form method="post" @formname="manage-set-active" @onsubmit="ToggleActivationAsync">
                <AntiforgeryToken />
                <div class="form-actions">
                    <button type="submit" class="button-primary">Reactivate account</button>
                </div>
            </form>
        }

        <p class="manage-back"><a href="/administration">Back to people</a></p>
    </section>
