@code {
    private static readonly string[] AllStaffRoles =
        [RestaurantRoles.Administrator, RestaurantRoles.Counter, RestaurantRoles.Kitchen];

    private PersonSummary? _person;
    private IReadOnlyList<string> _grantableRoles = [];
    private bool _isSelf;
    private string? _flashMessage;
    private string? _errorMessage;

    private CredentialResetResult? _resetResult;
    private string? _temporaryPassword;

    [Parameter]
    public Guid PersonId { get; set; }

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "manage-grant-role")]
    private RoleSelectionModel GrantInput { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "manage-revoke-role")]
    private RoleSelectionModel RevokeInput { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private string? Done { get; set; }

    private string ManagePath => $"/administration/people/{PersonId}";

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        GrantInput ??= new();
        RevokeInput ??= new();

        _person = await People.GetPersonAsync(PersonId, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        if (_person is null)
        {
            return;
        }

        _grantableRoles = AllStaffRoles.Where(role => !_person.Roles.Contains(role)).ToArray();

        Person? actingAdministrator = await UserManager.GetUserAsync(HttpContext.User);
        _isSelf = actingAdministrator is not null && actingAdministrator.PersonIdentifier == _person.PersonIdentifier;

        if (HttpContext.Request.Method == HttpMethods.Get)
        {
            _flashMessage = FlashFor(Done);
        }
    }

    private async Task GrantRoleAsync()
    {
        if (_person is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo("/administration");
            return;
        }

        Person? admin = await UserManager.GetUserAsync(HttpContext.User);
        if (admin is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(AccountRoutes.SignIn);
            return;
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(GrantInput.RoleName))
        {
            _errorMessage = "Choose a role to grant.";
            return;
        }

        RoleGrantOutcome outcome = await Accounts.GrantRoleAsync(
            _person.PersonIdentifier, GrantInput.RoleName, admin.PersonIdentifier, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        switch (outcome)
        {
            case RoleGrantOutcome.Granted:
                RedirectWithOutcome("role-granted");
                break;
            case RoleGrantOutcome.AlreadyHeld:
                RedirectWithOutcome("role-already-held");
                break;
            case RoleGrantOutcome.PersonNotFound:
                Navigation.NavigateTo(ManagePath);
                break;
        }
    }

    private async Task RevokeRoleAsync()
    {
        if (_person is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo("/administration");
            return;
        }

        Person? admin = await UserManager.GetUserAsync(HttpContext.User);
        if (admin is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(AccountRoutes.SignIn);
            return;
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(RevokeInput.RoleName))
        {
            _errorMessage = "Choose a role to revoke.";
            return;
        }

        RoleRevokeOutcome outcome = await Accounts.RevokeRoleAsync(
            _person.PersonIdentifier, RevokeInput.RoleName, admin.PersonIdentifier, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        switch (outcome)
        {
            case RoleRevokeOutcome.Revoked:
                RedirectWithOutcome("role-revoked");
                break;
            case RoleRevokeOutcome.NotHeld:
                RedirectWithOutcome("role-not-held");
                break;
            case RoleRevokeOutcome.WouldRemoveLastAdministrator:
                _errorMessage = "This is the only administrator, so the administrator role cannot be removed. "
                    + "Grant administrator to someone else first.";
                break;
            case RoleRevokeOutcome.PersonNotFound:
                Navigation.NavigateTo(ManagePath);
                break;
        }
    }

    private async Task ResetCredentialsAsync()
    {
        if (_person is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo("/administration");
            return;
        }

        Person? admin = await UserManager.GetUserAsync(HttpContext.User);
        if (admin is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(AccountRoutes.SignIn);
            return;
        }

        string temporaryPassword = SecretGenerator.GenerateBase64UrlSecret(12);
        string passwordHash = PasswordHasher.HashPassword(
            new Person { PersonIdentifier = _person.PersonIdentifier, Username = _person.Username },
            temporaryPassword);

        CredentialResetResult result = await Accounts.ResetCredentialsAsync(
            _person.PersonIdentifier, passwordHash, admin.PersonIdentifier, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        if (result.Outcome == CredentialResetOutcome.PersonNotFound)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(ManagePath);
            return;
        }

        _temporaryPassword = temporaryPassword;
        _resetResult = result;
    }

    private async Task ToggleActivationAsync()
    {
        if (_person is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo("/administration");
            return;
        }

        Person? admin = await UserManager.GetUserAsync(HttpContext.User);
        if (admin is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(AccountRoutes.SignIn);
            return;
        }

        bool target = !_person.IsActive;
        AccountActivationOutcome outcome = await Accounts.SetAccountActiveAsync(
            _person.PersonIdentifier, target, admin.PersonIdentifier, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        switch (outcome)
        {
            case AccountActivationOutcome.Changed:
                RedirectWithOutcome(target ? "account-reactivated" : "account-deactivated");
                break;
            case AccountActivationOutcome.NoChange:
                Navigation.NavigateTo(ManagePath);
                break;
            case AccountActivationOutcome.WouldDeactivateLastAdministrator:
                _errorMessage = "This is the only administrator that can sign in, so it cannot be deactivated. "
                    + "Make sure another administrator is active first.";
                break;
            case AccountActivationOutcome.PersonNotFound:
                Navigation.NavigateTo(ManagePath);
                break;
        }
    }

    private void RedirectWithOutcome(string outcome)
        => Navigation.NavigateTo($"{ManagePath}?done={outcome}");

    private static string? FlashFor(string? outcome) => outcome switch
    {
        "role-granted" => "Role granted. It takes effect on their sessions within a few minutes.",
        "role-already-held" => "That role was already held — nothing changed.",
        "role-revoked" => "Role revoked. It takes effect on their sessions within a few minutes.",
        "role-not-held" => "That role was not held — nothing changed.",
        "account-deactivated" => "Account deactivated. Its sessions end within a few minutes.",
        "account-reactivated" => "Account reactivated.",
        _ => null,
    };

    private bool IsLockedOut(PersonSummary person)
        => person.LockoutEndAt is { } end && end > Clock.UtcNow;

    private static string Capitalize(string role)
        => string.IsNullOrEmpty(role) ? role : char.ToUpperInvariant(role[0]) + role[1..];

    private sealed class RoleSelectionModel
    {
        public string RoleName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }
}

@code {
    private sealed record BillablePerson(Guid PersonIdentifier, string Name);

    private const string AdjustAction = "adjust";

    private const string RemoveAction = "remove";

    private CounterSittingSummary? _sitting;
    private IReadOnlyList<SittingMemberSummary> _members = [];
    private IReadOnlyList<SittingBillEntry> _bill = [];
    private IReadOnlyList<OrderLineView> _lines = [];

    private string? _errorMessage;
    private IReadOnlyList<string> _rejectionReasons = [];

    public Guid SittingId { get; set; }

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "sitting-correct-line")]
    private CorrectLineInputModel CorrectInput { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "sitting-add-line")]
    private AddLineInputModel AddInput { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private string? Done { get; set; }

    private string RecordPath => $"/administration/sittings/{SittingId}";

    private string CounterPath => $"/counter/sittings/{SittingId}";

    private decimal TableTotal => _bill.Sum(entry => entry.PersonTotalAmount);

    private string SettledSuffix
    {
        get
        {
            if (_sitting is not { ClosedAt: { } closedAt })
            {
                return string.Empty;
            }

            string by = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_sitting.ClosedByName)
                ? string.Empty
                : $" by {_sitting.ClosedByName}";

            return $" · settled {RestaurantClock.DateAndTime(closedAt)}{by}";
        }
    }

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        CorrectInput ??= new();
        AddInput ??= new();

        await LoadAsync();

        if (_sitting is null)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (HttpMethods.IsGet(HttpContext.Request.Method))
        {
            CorrectInput.Action = AdjustAction;
            AddInput.Quantity = 1;
            _flashMessage = FlashFor(Done);
        }
    }

    private async Task LoadAsync()
    {
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = HttpContext.RequestAborted;

        _sitting = await CounterReads.GetSittingAsync(SittingId, cancellationToken);

        if (_sitting is null)
        {
            _members = [];
            _bill = [];
            _lines = [];
            _records = [];
            _menu = [];
            _peopleAtTheTable = [];
            _eventCount = 0;
            return;
        }

        _members = await SittingDirectory.ListMembersAsync(SittingId, cancellationToken);
        _bill = await OrderReads.ListSittingBillAsync(SittingId, cancellationToken);
        _lines = await OrderReads.ListLinesForSittingAsync(SittingId, cancellationToken);
        _records = await SittingRecords.ListOrderRecordsForSittingAsync(SittingId, cancellationToken);
        _menu = await MenuItems.ListAsync(cancellationToken);

        _eventCount = _records.Sum(order => order.Events.Count);
        _peopleAtTheTable = BuildPeopleAtTheTable();
    }

    private IReadOnlyList<BillablePerson> BuildPeopleAtTheTable()
    {
        List<BillablePerson> people = _members
            .Select(member => new BillablePerson(member.PersonIdentifier, member.RosterName))
            .ToList();

        foreach (SittingBillEntry entry in _bill)
        {
            if (!people.Any(person => person.PersonIdentifier == entry.PersonIdentifier))
            {
                people.Add(new BillablePerson(entry.PersonIdentifier, entry.BillName));
            }
        }

        return people;
    }

    private async Task CorrectLineAsync()
    {
        if (!TryBegin(out Guid administrator))
        {
            return;
        }

        if (!Guid.TryParse(CorrectInput.OrderLineIdentifier, out Guid orderLineIdentifier))
        {
            _errorMessage = "Choose which line to correct.";
            return;
        }

        OrderLineView? line = _lines
            .FirstOrDefault(candidate => candidate.OrderLineIdentifier == orderLineIdentifier);

        if (line is null)
        {
            _errorMessage = "That line is no longer on the bill. The record below has been refreshed.";
            await LoadAsync();
            return;
        }

        if (CorrectInput.Action == RemoveAction)
        {
            await AppendAsync(
                administrator,
                line.GuestOrderIdentifier,
                OrderEventType.StaffEdit,
                [new LineRemovedOperation(orderLineIdentifier, Blank(CorrectInput.Reason))],
                "line-removed");
            return;
        }

        if (CorrectInput.Action != AdjustAction)
        {
            _errorMessage = "Choose whether to change the price or take the line off the bill.";
            return;
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(CorrectInput.Reason))
        {
            _errorMessage = "A price change needs a reason — it is the sentence somebody reads back later.";
            return;
        }

        if (CorrectInput.NewUnitPriceAmount < 0m)
        {
            _errorMessage = "A price cannot be negative.";
            return;
        }

        decimal newUnitPrice = Math.Round(CorrectInput.NewUnitPriceAmount, 2, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero);

        await AppendAsync(
            administrator,
            line.GuestOrderIdentifier,
            OrderEventType.PriceAdjustment,
            [new LinePriceAdjustedOperation(orderLineIdentifier, newUnitPrice, CorrectInput.Reason.Trim())],
            "line-repriced");
    }

    private async Task AddLineAsync()
    {
        if (!TryBegin(out Guid administrator))
        {
            return;
        }

        if (!Guid.TryParse(AddInput.PersonIdentifier, out Guid personIdentifier)
            || _peopleAtTheTable.All(person => person.PersonIdentifier != personIdentifier))
        {
            _errorMessage = "Choose which guest this line belongs to.";
            return;
        }

        if (!Guid.TryParse(AddInput.MenuItemIdentifier, out Guid menuItemIdentifier))
        {
            _errorMessage = "Choose an item to add.";
            return;
        }

        MenuItemSummary? item = _menu
            .FirstOrDefault(candidate => candidate.MenuItemIdentifier == menuItemIdentifier);

        if (item is null)
        {
            _errorMessage = "That item is no longer on the menu.";
            return;
        }

        if (!item.IsActive)
        {
            _errorMessage =
                $"{item.Name} is currently marked unavailable, so it cannot be added. Make it available first.";
            return;
        }

        if (AddInput.Quantity is < 1 or > 100)
        {
            _errorMessage = "Quantity must be between 1 and 100.";
            return;
        }

        LineAddedOperation added = new(
            Identifiers.Create(),
            menuItemIdentifier,
            AddInput.Quantity,
            item.PriceAmount,
            Blank(AddInput.Note));

        AppendOrderEventResult result = await Workflow.AppendStaffEventToLivingOrderAsync(
            SittingId,
            personIdentifier,
            new ProposedOrderEvent(
                OrderEventType.StaffEdit,
                administrator,
                OrderActorRole.Administrator,
                [added]),
            HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        await ReportAsync(result, "line-added");
    }

    private async Task AppendAsync(
        Guid administrator,
        Guid guestOrderIdentifier,
        OrderEventType eventType,
        IReadOnlyList<OrderOperation> operations,
        string outcome)
    {
        AppendOrderEventResult result = await Workflow.AppendStaffEventAsync(
            guestOrderIdentifier,
            new ProposedOrderEvent(eventType, administrator, OrderActorRole.Administrator, operations),
            HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        await ReportAsync(result, outcome);
    }

    private async Task ReportAsync(AppendOrderEventResult result, string outcome)
    {
        if (result.IsAppended)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo($"{RecordPath}?done={outcome}");
            return;
        }

        _errorMessage = DescribeRefusal(result);
        _rejectionReasons = result.Errors.Select(error => error.Reason).ToArray();
        await LoadAsync();
    }

    private static string DescribeRefusal(AppendOrderEventResult result) => result.Outcome switch
    {
        AppendOrderEventOutcome.SittingNotFound => "That sitting no longer exists. Nothing was written.",
        AppendOrderEventOutcome.OrderNotFound => "There is no order here to append to. Nothing was written.",
        _ => "Nothing was written. The record below has been refreshed.",
    };

    private bool TryBegin(out Guid administrator)
    {
        administrator = Guid.Empty;

        if (_sitting is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo("/administration/sittings");
            return false;
        }

        if (_sitting.IsOpen)
        {
            _errorMessage =
                "This table is still open, so there is nothing to correct. Settle it at the counter first.";
            return false;
        }

        if (PersonPrincipal.IdentifierFor(HttpContext.User) is not { } identifier)
        {
            _errorMessage = "Your session could not be identified. Sign in again and retry.";
            return false;
        }

        administrator = identifier;
        return true;
    }

    private bool HasAnOrder(Guid personIdentifier)
        => _bill.Any(entry => entry.PersonIdentifier == personIdentifier);

    private IReadOnlyList<OrderLineView> LinesFor(Guid guestOrderIdentifier)
        => _lines.Where(line => line.GuestOrderIdentifier == guestOrderIdentifier).ToArray();

    private string LineOptionLabel(OrderLineView line)
        => $"{OwnerNameFor(line.GuestOrderIdentifier)} — {line.Quantity} × {line.MenuItemName} " +
           $"at {Money(line.CurrentUnitPriceAmount)}";

    private string OwnerNameFor(Guid guestOrderIdentifier)
    {
        SittingBillEntry? entry = _bill
            .FirstOrDefault(candidate => candidate.GuestOrderIdentifier == guestOrderIdentifier);

        if (entry is not null)
        {
            return entry.BillName;
        }

        SittingOrderRecord? orderRecord = _records
            .FirstOrDefault(candidate => candidate.GuestOrderIdentifier == guestOrderIdentifier);

        return orderRecord?.OwnerName ?? "Unknown guest";
    }

    private string ItemOptionLabel(MenuItemSummary item)
        => item.IsActive
            ? $"{item.Name} — {Money(item.PriceAmount)}"
            : $"{item.Name} — {Money(item.PriceAmount)} (currently unavailable)";

    private static string DescribeEventType(string eventType) => eventType switch
    {
        "guest_submission" => "Guest send",
        "staff_edit" => "Staff edit",
        "price_adjustment" => "Price change",
        "fulfillment" => "Delivered",
        "fulfillment_reversal" => "Delivery undone",
        _ => eventType,
    };

    private static string DescribeActorRole(string actorRole) => actorRole switch
    {
        "guest" => "a guest",
        "kitchen" => "the kitchen",
        "counter" => "the counter",
        "administrator" => "an administrator",
        _ => actorRole,
    };

    private string DescribeOperation(StoredOrderOperation operation) => operation.OperationKind switch
    {
        "line_added" =>
            $"Added {operation.Quantity} × {operation.MenuItemName} at " +
            $"{Money(operation.UnitPriceAmount ?? 0m)} each{NoteSuffix(operation.CustomizationNote)}",
        "line_removed" =>
            $"Removed {operation.Quantity} × {operation.MenuItemName}{ReasonSuffix(operation.Reason)}",
        "line_price_adjusted" =>
            $"{operation.Quantity} × {operation.MenuItemName} repriced to " +
            $"{Money(operation.NewUnitPriceAmount ?? 0m)} each{ReasonSuffix(operation.Reason)}",
        "line_fulfilled" =>
            $"{operation.Quantity} × {operation.MenuItemName} delivered",
        "line_fulfillment_reverted" =>
            $"{operation.Quantity} × {operation.MenuItemName} put back with the kitchen",
        _ => $"{operation.OperationKind} on {operation.Quantity} × {operation.MenuItemName}",
    };

    private static string NoteSuffix(string? note)
        => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(note) ? string.Empty : $" — “{note.Trim()}”";

    private static string ReasonSuffix(string? reason)
        => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(reason) ? string.Empty : $" — {reason.Trim()}";

    private static string? FlashFor(string? outcome) => outcome switch
    {
        "line-repriced" =>
            "Price changed. The settled total above is unchanged — the correction shows beside it.",
        "line-removed" =>
            "Line taken off the bill. It stays in the record with your name and the reason; it simply stops being charged.",
        "line-added" =>
            "Line added. It appears in the corrected total, not in the settled one, which is never rewritten.",
        _ => null,
    };

    private static string? Blank(string? value)
        => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) ? null : value.Trim();

    private string Money(decimal amount) => MoneyText.Format(amount, Options.CurrencyCode);

    private sealed class CorrectLineInputModel
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Choose which line to correct.")]
        public string OrderLineIdentifier { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Choose what to do.")]
        public string Action { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        [Range(0, 99999999.99, ErrorMessage = "The price must be between 0 and 99,999,999.99.")]
        public decimal NewUnitPriceAmount { get; set; }

        [StringLength(200, ErrorMessage = "A reason must be 200 characters or fewer.")]
        public string? Reason { get; set; }
    }

    private sealed class AddLineInputModel
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Choose which guest this line belongs to.")]
        public string PersonIdentifier { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Choose an item to add.")]
        public string MenuItemIdentifier { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        [Range(1, 100, ErrorMessage = "Quantity must be between 1 and 100.")]
        public int Quantity { get; set; } = 1;

        [StringLength(500, ErrorMessage = "A note must be 500 characters or fewer.")]
        public string? Note { get; set; }
    }
}

@code {
    private RestaurantTableSummary? _table;
    private string? _flashMessage;
    private string? _errorMessage;

    [Parameter]
    public Guid TableId { get; set; }

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "manage-rename")]
    private RenameInputModel RenameInput { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private string? Done { get; set; }

    private string ManagePath => $"/administration/tables/{TableId}";

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        RenameInput ??= new();

        _table = await TableDirectory.GetTableAsync(TableId, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        if (_table is null)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (HttpContext.Request.Method == HttpMethods.Get)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(RenameInput.Label))
            {
                RenameInput.Label = _table.Label;
            }

            _flashMessage = FlashFor(Done);
        }
    }

    private async Task RenameAsync()
    {
        if (_table is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo("/administration/tables");
            return;
        }

        RenameTableOutcome outcome = await Tables.RenameTableAsync(
            TableId, RenameInput.Label.Trim(), HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        switch (outcome)
        {
            case RenameTableOutcome.Renamed:
                RedirectWithOutcome("renamed");
                break;
            case RenameTableOutcome.NoChange:
                RedirectWithOutcome("rename-no-change");
                break;
            case RenameTableOutcome.LabelTaken:
                _errorMessage = "Another table already uses that label. Please choose a different one.";
                break;
            case RenameTableOutcome.TableNotFound:
                Navigation.NavigateTo("/administration/tables");
                break;
        }
    }

    private async Task RotateSecretAsync()
    {
        if (_table is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo("/administration/tables");
            return;
        }

        RotateJoinSecretOutcome outcome = await Tables.RotateJoinSecretAsync(TableId, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        switch (outcome)
        {
            case RotateJoinSecretOutcome.Rotated:
                RedirectWithOutcome("secret-rotated");
                break;
            case RotateJoinSecretOutcome.TableNotFound:
                Navigation.NavigateTo("/administration/tables");
                break;
        }
    }

    private async Task ToggleActivationAsync()
    {
        if (_table is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo("/administration/tables");
            return;
        }

        bool target = !_table.IsActive;
        TableActivationOutcome outcome = await Tables.SetTableActiveAsync(TableId, target, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        switch (outcome)
        {
            case TableActivationOutcome.Changed:
                RedirectWithOutcome(target ? "reactivated" : "deactivated");
                break;
            case TableActivationOutcome.NoChange:
                Navigation.NavigateTo(ManagePath);
                break;
            case TableActivationOutcome.TableNotFound:
                Navigation.NavigateTo("/administration/tables");
                break;
        }
    }

    private void RedirectWithOutcome(string outcome)
        => Navigation.NavigateTo($"{ManagePath}?done={outcome}");

    private static string? FlashFor(string? outcome) => outcome switch
    {
        "renamed" => "Table renamed.",
        "rename-no-change" => "That was already the label — nothing changed.",
        "secret-rotated" => "Join secret rotated. Every outstanding QR for this table has stopped working; "
            + "paired displays pick up the new one automatically.",
        "deactivated" => "Table deactivated. Its join tokens no longer validate and its display stops rendering.",
        "reactivated" => "Table reactivated.",
        _ => null,
    };

    private sealed class RenameInputModel
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Enter a label.")]
        [StringLength(64, MinimumLength = 1, ErrorMessage = "The label must be 1–64 characters.")]
        public string Label { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }
}

@code {
    private RestaurantTableSummary? _table;
    private IReadOnlyList<TableDisplayDeviceSummary> _devices = [];
    private IReadOnlyList<TableDisplayDeviceSummary> _revocableDevices = [];
    private string? _issuedCode;
    private DateTimeOffset? _issuedExpiresAt;
    private string? _flashMessage;
    private string? _errorMessage;

    [Parameter]
    public Guid TableId { get; set; }

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "display-revoke")]
    private RevokeInputModel RevokeInput { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    private string? Done { get; set; }

    private string ManagePath => $"/administration/tables/{TableId}";

    private string DisplaysPath => $"/administration/tables/{TableId}/displays";

    private string PairingUrl => $"{Options.PublicOrigin.TrimEnd('/')}{DisplayRoutes.Pair}";

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        RevokeInput ??= new();

        _table = await TableDirectory.GetTableAsync(TableId, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        if (_table is null)
        {
            return;
        }

        await LoadDevicesAsync();

        if (HttpMethods.IsGet(HttpContext.Request.Method))
        {
            _flashMessage = FlashFor(Done);
        }
    }

    private async Task LoadDevicesAsync()
    {
        _devices = await DisplayDevices.ListDevicesForTableAsync(TableId, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        _revocableDevices = _devices.Where(device => !device.IsRevoked).ToArray();
    }

    private async Task GenerateCodeAsync()
    {
        if (_table is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo("/administration/tables");
            return;
        }

        if (PersonPrincipal.IdentifierFor(HttpContext.User) is not { } administrator)
        {
            _errorMessage = "Your session could not be identified. Sign in again and retry.";
            return;
        }

        IssuePairingCodeResult result = await Pairing.IssuePairingCodeAsync(
            TableId,
            administrator,
            TimeSpan.FromMinutes(Options.TableDisplayPairingCodeMinutes),
            HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        if (result.Outcome == IssuePairingCodeOutcome.Issued)
        {
            _issuedCode = result.Code;
            _issuedExpiresAt = result.ExpiresAt;
            return;
        }

        _errorMessage = "This table is deactivated, so it cannot take a new display. Reactivate it first.";
    }

    private async Task RevokeDeviceAsync()
    {
        if (_table is null)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo("/administration/tables");
            return;
        }

        if (!Guid.TryParse(RevokeInput.DeviceIdentifier, out Guid deviceIdentifier))
        {
            _errorMessage = "Choose which display to revoke.";
            return;
        }

        if (PersonPrincipal.IdentifierFor(HttpContext.User) is not { } administrator)
        {
            _errorMessage = "Your session could not be identified. Sign in again and retry.";
            return;
        }

        RevokeDisplayDeviceOutcome outcome = await Pairing.RevokeDeviceAsync(
            deviceIdentifier, administrator, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        switch (outcome)
        {
            case RevokeDisplayDeviceOutcome.Revoked:
                Navigation.NavigateTo($"{DisplaysPath}?done=revoked");
                break;
            case RevokeDisplayDeviceOutcome.AlreadyRevoked:
                Navigation.NavigateTo($"{DisplaysPath}?done=already-revoked");
                break;
            case RevokeDisplayDeviceOutcome.DeviceNotFound:
                _errorMessage = "That display no longer exists.";
                await LoadDevicesAsync();
                break;
        }
    }

    private static string? FlashFor(string? outcome) => outcome switch
    {
        "revoked" => "Display revoked. Its credential stops working on the device's next request.",
        "already-revoked" => "That display had already been revoked — nothing changed.",
        _ => null,
    };

    private sealed class RevokeInputModel
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Choose which display to revoke.")]
        public string DeviceIdentifier { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }
}

@code {
    private static readonly TimeSpan RecentlySettledWindow = TimeSpan.FromHours(12);

    private const int RecentlySettledLimit = 25;

    private readonly CancellationTokenSource _lifetime = new();
    private CancellationToken _stopping;
    private IDisposable? _subscription;
    private bool _disposed;

    private bool _loaded;
    private IReadOnlyList<CounterSittingSummary> _openSittings = [];
    private IReadOnlyList<CounterSittingSummary> _recentlySettled = [];

    private decimal _openTotal;
    private int _openPendingLines;

    private string IsLiveAttributeValue => RendererInfo.IsInteractive ? "true" : "false";

    private string IsLoadedAttributeValue => _loaded ? "true" : "false";

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        _stopping = _lifetime.Token;
        await LoadAsync();
        _loaded = true;
    }

    protected override void OnAfterRender(bool firstRender)
    {
        if (firstRender)
        {
            _subscription = Broadcaster.Subscribe(OnDomainNotification);
        }
    }

    private async Task LoadAsync()
    {
        _openSittings = await CounterReads.ListOpenSittingsAsync(_stopping);

        _recentlySettled = await CounterReads.ListRecentlyClosedSittingsAsync(
            Clock.UtcNow - RecentlySettledWindow,
            RecentlySettledLimit,
            _stopping);

        _openTotal = _openSittings.Sum(sitting => sitting.CurrentTotalAmount);
        _openPendingLines = _openSittings.Sum(sitting => sitting.PendingLineCount);
    }

    private void OnDomainNotification(DomainNotification notification)
    {
        bool concernsTheFloor = notification
            is OrderLinesChanged
            or LineFulfillmentChanged
            or SittingClosed
            or SittingMemberJoined;

        if (!concernsTheFloor)
        {
            return;
        }

        _ = InvokeAsync(async () =>
        {
            if (_disposed)
            {
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                await LoadAsync();
                StateHasChanged();
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
            }
            catch (ObjectDisposedException)
            {
            }
        });
    }

    private string Money(decimal amount) => MoneyText.Format(amount, Options.CurrencyCode);

    private static string SittingPath(Guid sittingIdentifier) => $"/counter/sittings/{sittingIdentifier}";

    private static string JoinCodePath(Guid tableIdentifier) => $"/counter/tables/{tableIdentifier}/join-code";

    private string Elapsed(DateTimeOffset since)
    {
        TimeSpan elapsed = Clock.UtcNow - since;

        if (elapsed < TimeSpan.Zero)
        {
            elapsed = TimeSpan.Zero;
        }

        if (elapsed < TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1))
        {
            return "under a minute";
        }

        int minutes = (int)elapsed.TotalMinutes;
        if (minutes < 60)
        {
            return $"{minutes}m";
        }

        int hours = minutes / 60;
        return $"{hours}h {minutes % 60:D2}m";
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (_disposed)
        {
            return;
        }

        _disposed = true;
        _subscription?.Dispose();
        _lifetime.Cancel();
        _lifetime.Dispose();
    }
}

<PageTitle>@(_table is null ? "Join code" : $"Join code — {_table.Label}")</PageTitle>

@if (_table is null)
{
    <section class="panel account-panel">
        <p class="eyebrow">Counter</p>
        <h1>Table not found</h1>
        <p class="lede">No table exists with that identifier. It may have never existed, or the link is stale.</p>
        <p><a href="/counter">Back to the counter</a></p>
    </section>
}
else if (!_table.IsActive)
{
    <section class="panel account-panel">
        <p class="eyebrow">Counter</p>
        <h1>@_table.Label</h1>
        <p class="lede">
            This table is deactivated, so its join code does not render and its tokens do not validate
            (§4.1). An administrator can reactivate it from the administration area.
        </p>
        <p class="counter-code-back"><a href="/counter">Back to the counter</a></p>
    </section>
}
else if (_qr is null)
{
    <section class="panel account-panel">
        <p class="eyebrow">Counter</p>
        <h1>@_table.Label</h1>
        <p class="status-error" role="alert">The join code could not be generated just now. Try again.</p>
        <p class="counter-code-back"><a href="@JoinCodePath">Try again</a></p>
    </section>
}
else
{
    <section class="panel account-panel counter-code-panel">
        <p class="eyebrow">Counter — join code</p>
        <h1>@_table.Label</h1>
        <p class="lede">
            Hold this up for the guest to scan. It is the same rotating code @_table.Label's own display
            shows (§4.5) — use it when that display is down. The private join secret never leaves the
            server.
        </p>

        <div class="counter-qr">
            @((MarkupString)_qr.QrCodeSvg)
        </div>

        <p class="counter-code-url-label">The code links to:</p>
        <p class="counter-code-url">@_qr.JoinUrl</p>

        <p class="counter-code-rotation">
            Rotates every @Options.TableJoinTokenRotationSeconds seconds — next at
            <strong>@RestaurantClock.TimeWithSeconds(_qr.NextRotationAt)</strong>
            (about @SecondsUntilRotation second@(SecondsUntilRotation == 1 ? "" : "s") from now). A code
            that has just been scanned keeps working for up to about
            @(Options.TableJoinTokenRotationSeconds * 2) seconds, so it will not stop working while a
            guest is pointing a phone at it.
        </p>

        <div class="form-actions">
            <a class="button-primary" href="@JoinCodePath">Show a fresh code</a>
            <a class="button-secondary" href="/counter">Back to the counter</a>
        </div>
    </section>
}

@code {
    private RestaurantTableSummary? _table;
    private TableJoinQrCode? _qr;

    [Parameter]
    public Guid TableId { get; set; }

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    private string JoinCodePath => $"/counter/tables/{TableId}/join-code";

    private int SecondsUntilRotation => _qr is null
        ? 0
        : Math.Max(0, (int)Math.Ceiling((_qr.NextRotationAt - _qr.GeneratedAt).TotalSeconds));

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        _table = await TableDirectory.GetTableAsync(TableId, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        if (_table is null || !_table.IsActive)
        {
            return;
        }

        _qr = await JoinTokens.DescribeCurrentAsync(TableId, HttpContext.RequestAborted);
    }
}

</section>

@code {
    private sealed record BillablePerson(Guid PersonIdentifier, string Name);

    private readonly CancellationTokenSource _lifetime = new();
    private CancellationToken _stopping;
    private IDisposable? _subscription;
    private bool _disposed;

    private Guid? _person;
    private OrderActorRole _actorRole = OrderActorRole.Counter;
    private bool _loaded;
    private bool _busy;

    private CounterSittingSummary? _sitting;
    private IReadOnlyList<SittingBillEntry> _bill = [];
    private IReadOnlyList<OrderLineView> _lines = [];
    private IReadOnlyList<SittingMemberSummary> _members = [];
    private IReadOnlyList<MenuItemSummary> _menu = [];

    private string? _notice;
    private string? _problem;
    private IReadOnlyList<string> _rejectionReasons = [];

    private Guid? _adjustingLine;
    private string _adjustPriceText = string.Empty;
    private string _adjustReason = string.Empty;

    private Guid? _removingLine;
    private string _removeReason = string.Empty;

    private string _addPersonText = string.Empty;
    private string _addMenuItemText = string.Empty;
    private int _addQuantity = 1;
    private string _addNote = string.Empty;

    private bool _confirmingClose;

    [Parameter]
    [EditorRequired]
    public Guid SittingId { get; set; }

    [CascadingParameter]
    private Task<AuthenticationState>? AuthenticationStateTask { get; set; }

    private decimal TableTotal => _bill.Sum(entry => entry.PersonTotalAmount);

    private IReadOnlyList<SittingMemberSummary> MembersWithoutAnOrder
        => _members
            .Where(member => !_bill.Any(entry => entry.PersonIdentifier == member.PersonIdentifier))
            .ToArray();

    private IReadOnlyList<BillablePerson> PeopleAtTheTable
    {
        get
        {
            List<BillablePerson> people = _members
                .Select(member => new BillablePerson(member.PersonIdentifier, member.RosterName))
                .ToList();

            foreach (SittingBillEntry entry in _bill)
            {
                if (!people.Any(person => person.PersonIdentifier == entry.PersonIdentifier))
                {
                    people.Add(new BillablePerson(entry.PersonIdentifier, entry.BillName));
                }
            }

            return people;
        }
    }

    private string SettledSuffix
    {
        get
        {
            if (_sitting is not { ClosedAt: { } closedAt })
            {
                return string.Empty;
            }

            string by = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_sitting.ClosedByName)
                ? string.Empty
                : $" by {_sitting.ClosedByName}";

            return $" · settled {RestaurantClock.DateAndTime(closedAt)}{by}";
        }
    }

    private string JoinCodePath
        => _sitting is null ? "/counter" : $"/counter/tables/{_sitting.TableIdentifier}/join-code";

    private string IsLiveAttributeValue => RendererInfo.IsInteractive ? "true" : "false";

    private string IsLoadedAttributeValue => _loaded ? "true" : "false";

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        _stopping = _lifetime.Token;

        if (AuthenticationStateTask is not null)
        {
            AuthenticationState state = await AuthenticationStateTask;
            _person = PersonPrincipal.IdentifierFor(state.User);

            _actorRole = state.User.IsInRole(RestaurantRoles.Counter)
                ? OrderActorRole.Counter
                : OrderActorRole.Administrator;
        }

        await LoadAsync();
        _loaded = true;
    }

    protected override void OnAfterRender(bool firstRender)
    {
        if (firstRender)
        {
            _subscription = Broadcaster.Subscribe(OnDomainNotification);
        }
    }

    private async Task LoadAsync()
    {
        _sitting = await CounterReads.GetSittingAsync(SittingId, _stopping);

        if (_sitting is null)
        {
            _bill = [];
            _lines = [];
            _members = [];
            return;
        }

        _bill = await OrderReads.ListSittingBillAsync(SittingId, _stopping);
        _lines = await OrderReads.ListLinesForSittingAsync(SittingId, _stopping);
        _members = await SittingDirectory.ListMembersAsync(SittingId, _stopping);
        _menu = await MenuDirectory.ListAsync(_stopping);
    }

    private IReadOnlyList<OrderLineView> LinesFor(Guid guestOrderIdentifier)
        => _lines.Where(line => line.GuestOrderIdentifier == guestOrderIdentifier).ToArray();

    private string ItemOptionLabel(MenuItemSummary item)
        => item.IsActive
            ? $"{item.Name} — {Money(item.PriceAmount)}"
            : $"{item.Name} — {Money(item.PriceAmount)} (currently unavailable)";

    private void StartAdjust(OrderLineView line)
    {
        CancelEditors();
        _adjustingLine = line.OrderLineIdentifier;
        _adjustPriceText = line.CurrentUnitPriceAmount.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        _adjustReason = string.Empty;
    }

    private void StartRemove(OrderLineView line)
    {
        CancelEditors();
        _removingLine = line.OrderLineIdentifier;
        _removeReason = string.Empty;
    }

    private void CancelEditors()
    {
        _adjustingLine = null;
        _removingLine = null;
        _confirmingClose = false;
    }

    private void BeginClose()
    {
        CancelEditors();
        _confirmingClose = true;
    }

    private void AbandonClose()
    {
        _confirmingClose = false;
    }

    private async Task AdjustPriceAsync(OrderLineView line)
    {
        ClearMessages();

        if (!decimal.TryParse(
                _adjustPriceText,
                NumberStyles.Number,
                CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                out decimal newUnitPrice)
            || newUnitPrice < 0m)
        {
            _problem = "Enter the new unit price as a plain number, for example 12.50.";
            return;
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_adjustReason))
        {
            _problem = "A price adjustment needs a reason — it is shown beside the change on the bill.";
            return;
        }

        newUnitPrice = Math.Round(newUnitPrice, 2, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero);

        bool appended = await AppendToOrderAsync(
            line.GuestOrderIdentifier,
            OrderEventType.PriceAdjustment,
            [new LinePriceAdjustedOperation(line.OrderLineIdentifier, newUnitPrice, _adjustReason.Trim())],
            $"{line.MenuItemName} is now {Money(newUnitPrice)} each.");

        if (appended)
        {
            CancelEditors();
        }
    }

    private async Task RemoveLineAsync(OrderLineView line)
    {
        bool appended = await AppendToOrderAsync(
            line.GuestOrderIdentifier,
            OrderEventType.StaffEdit,
            [new LineRemovedOperation(line.OrderLineIdentifier, Blank(_removeReason))],
            $"{line.Quantity} × {line.MenuItemName} is off the bill.");

        if (appended)
        {
            CancelEditors();
        }
    }

    private async Task AddLineAsync()
    {
        ClearMessages();

        if (!Guid.TryParse(_addPersonText, out Guid personIdentifier))
        {
            _problem = "Choose which guest this is for.";
            return;
        }

        BillablePerson? recipient = PeopleAtTheTable
            .FirstOrDefault(person => person.PersonIdentifier == personIdentifier);

        if (recipient is null)
        {
            _problem = "That guest is no longer at this table.";
            return;
        }

        if (!Guid.TryParse(_addMenuItemText, out Guid menuItemIdentifier))
        {
            _problem = "Choose an item to add.";
            return;
        }

        MenuItemSummary? item = _menu
            .FirstOrDefault(candidate => candidate.MenuItemIdentifier == menuItemIdentifier);

        if (item is null)
        {
            _problem = "That item is no longer on the menu.";
            return;
        }

        if (!item.IsActive)
        {
            _problem = $"{item.Name} is currently unavailable, so it cannot be added.";
            return;
        }

        if (_addQuantity is < 1 or > 100)
        {
            _problem = "Quantity must be between 1 and 100.";
            return;
        }

        LineAddedOperation added = new(
            Identifiers.Create(),
            menuItemIdentifier,
            _addQuantity,
            item.PriceAmount,
            Blank(_addNote));

        bool appended = await AppendToLivingOrderAsync(
            personIdentifier,
            OrderEventType.StaffEdit,
            [added],
            $"{_addQuantity} × {item.Name} added to {recipient.Name}'s order.");

        if (appended)
        {
            _addMenuItemText = string.Empty;
            _addQuantity = 1;
            _addNote = string.Empty;
        }
    }

    private async Task CloseAndSettleAsync()
    {
        if (_person is not { } person || _busy)
        {
            return;
        }

        _busy = true;
        ClearMessages();

        try
        {
            CloseSittingResult result = await Settlement.CloseAndSettleAsync(SittingId, person, _stopping);

            _confirmingClose = false;

            switch (result.Outcome)
            {
                case CloseSittingOutcome.Closed when result.PendingLineCountAtClose > 0:
                    _notice =
                        $"Settled at {Money(result.SettledTotalAmount ?? 0m)} — with " +
                        $"{result.PendingLineCountAtClose} " +
                        $"{(result.PendingLineCountAtClose == 1 ? "line" : "lines")} still with the kitchen.";
                    break;

                case CloseSittingOutcome.Closed:
                    _notice = $"Settled at {Money(result.SettledTotalAmount ?? 0m)}.";
                    break;

                case CloseSittingOutcome.AlreadyClosed:
                    _notice = $"This table had already been settled at {Money(result.SettledTotalAmount ?? 0m)}.";
                    break;

                default:
                    _problem = "That sitting no longer exists.";
                    break;
            }

            await LoadAsync();
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
        }
        finally
        {
            _busy = false;
        }
    }

    private async Task<bool> AppendToOrderAsync(
        Guid guestOrderIdentifier,
        OrderEventType eventType,
        IReadOnlyList<OrderOperation> operations,
        string successMessage)
    {
        if (_person is not { } person || _busy)
        {
            return false;
        }

        _busy = true;
        ClearMessages();

        try
        {
            AppendOrderEventResult result = await Workflow.AppendStaffEventAsync(
                guestOrderIdentifier,
                new ProposedOrderEvent(eventType, person, _actorRole, operations),
                _stopping);

            return await ReportAsync(result, successMessage);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            return false;
        }
        finally
        {
            _busy = false;
        }
    }

    private async Task<bool> AppendToLivingOrderAsync(
        Guid orderOwnerPersonIdentifier,
        OrderEventType eventType,
        IReadOnlyList<OrderOperation> operations,
        string successMessage)
    {
        if (_person is not { } person || _busy)
        {
            return false;
        }

        _busy = true;

        try
        {
            AppendOrderEventResult result = await Workflow.AppendStaffEventToLivingOrderAsync(
                SittingId,
                orderOwnerPersonIdentifier,
                new ProposedOrderEvent(eventType, person, _actorRole, operations),
                _stopping);

            return await ReportAsync(result, successMessage);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            return false;
        }
        finally
        {
            _busy = false;
        }
    }

    private async Task<bool> ReportAsync(AppendOrderEventResult result, string successMessage)
    {
        if (result.IsAppended)
        {
            _notice = successMessage;
        }
        else
        {
            _problem = DescribeRefusal(result);
            _rejectionReasons = result.Errors.Select(error => error.Reason).ToArray();
        }

        await LoadAsync();
        return result.IsAppended;
    }

    private static string DescribeRefusal(AppendOrderEventResult result)
    {
        if (result.Outcome is AppendOrderEventOutcome.SittingNotFound)
        {
            return "That sitting no longer exists. Nothing was changed.";
        }

        if (result.Outcome is AppendOrderEventOutcome.OrderNotFound)
        {
            return "There is no order to change here — the table may have been settled. Nothing was changed.";
        }

        return "Nothing was changed. The bill below has been refreshed.";
    }

    private void ClearMessages()
    {
        _notice = null;
        _problem = null;
        _rejectionReasons = [];
    }

    private void OnDomainNotification(DomainNotification notification)
    {
        bool concernsThisSitting = notification switch
        {
            OrderLinesChanged changed => changed.SittingIdentifier == SittingId,
            LineFulfillmentChanged fulfilled => fulfilled.SittingIdentifier == SittingId,
            SittingMemberJoined joined => joined.SittingIdentifier == SittingId,
            SittingClosed closed => closed.SittingIdentifier == SittingId,
            MenuChanged => true,
            _ => false,
        };

        if (!concernsThisSitting)
        {
            return;
        }

        _ = InvokeAsync(async () =>
        {
            if (_disposed)
            {
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                await LoadAsync();
                StateHasChanged();
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
            }
            catch (ObjectDisposedException)
            {
            }
        });
    }

    private string Money(decimal amount) => MoneyText.Format(amount, Options.CurrencyCode);

    private static string? Blank(string? value)
        => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) ? null : value.Trim();

    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (_disposed)
        {
            return;
        }

        _disposed = true;
        _subscription?.Dispose();
        _lifetime.Cancel();
        _lifetime.Dispose();
    }
}

@code {
    private string? _errorMessage;
    private bool _wasDisconnected;
    private Guid? _pairedTable;
    private string? _pairedTableLabel;

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "display-pair")]
    private PairInputModel PairInput { get; set; } = default!;

    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        PairInput ??= new();

        _pairedTable = DisplayDevicePrincipal.TableIdentifierFor(HttpContext.User);
        _pairedTableLabel = DisplayDevicePrincipal.TableLabelFor(HttpContext.User);
        _wasDisconnected = _pairedTable is null && DisplayDeviceCookie.WasPresented(HttpContext.Request);
    }

    private async Task PairAsync()
    {
        RedeemPairingCodeResult result = await Pairing.RedeemPairingCodeAsync(
            PairInput.Code, PairInput.DeviceLabel, HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        if (result.Outcome == RedeemPairingCodeOutcome.Paired
            && result.DeviceIdentifier is { } device
            && result.TableIdentifier is { } table
            && result.DeviceSecret is { } secret)
        {
            DisplayDeviceCookie.Write(HttpContext.Response, device, secret);
            Navigation.NavigateTo(DisplayRoutes.ForTable(table));
            return;
        }

        _errorMessage = "That code was not recognised. Codes work once and expire quickly — ask for a "
            + "fresh one and try again.";
    }

    private sealed class PairInputModel
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Enter the pairing code.")]
        [StringLength(32, MinimumLength = 8, ErrorMessage = "A pairing code is 8 characters.")]
        public string Code { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        [StringLength(120, ErrorMessage = "Keep the name under 120 characters.")]
        public string? DeviceLabel { get; set; }
    }
}

@code {
    private enum DisplayStage
    {
        NotPaired,

        WrongTable,

        TableOutOfService,

        Live,
    }

    private DisplayStage _stage = DisplayStage.NotPaired;
    private Guid? _deviceIdentifier;
    private Guid? _deviceTable;
    private string? _deviceTableLabel;
    private string _tableLabel = string.Empty;
    private TableJoinQrCode? _qr;
    private int _partySize;
    private int _refreshSequence;
    private bool _loaded;

    private readonly CancellationTokenSource _lifetime = new();
    private CancellationToken _stopping;
    private IDisposable? _subscription;
    private bool _liveWorkStarted;
    private bool _disposed;

    [Parameter]
    public Guid TableId { get; set; }

    [CascadingParameter]
    private Task<AuthenticationState>? AuthenticationStateTask { get; set; }

    private string PageTitleText => _stage == DisplayStage.NotPaired
        ? "Pair this display"
        : string.IsNullOrEmpty(_tableLabel) ? "Table display" : _tableLabel;

    private int FreshForMilliseconds
        => DisplayRefreshSchedule.FreshForMilliseconds(Options.TableJoinTokenRotationSeconds);

    private string IsLiveAttributeValue => RendererInfo.IsInteractive ? "true" : "false";

    private string IsLoadedAttributeValue => _loaded && _qr is not null ? "true" : "false";

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        _stopping = _lifetime.Token;

        if (AuthenticationStateTask is null)
        {
            _stage = DisplayStage.NotPaired;
            _loaded = true;
            return;
        }

        AuthenticationState state = await AuthenticationStateTask;

        _deviceIdentifier = DisplayDevicePrincipal.DeviceIdentifierFor(state.User);
        _deviceTable = DisplayDevicePrincipal.TableIdentifierFor(state.User);
        _deviceTableLabel = DisplayDevicePrincipal.TableLabelFor(state.User);

        if (_deviceIdentifier is null || _deviceTable is null)
        {
            _stage = DisplayStage.NotPaired;
            _loaded = true;
            Navigation.NavigateTo(DisplayRoutes.Pair);
            return;
        }

        if (_deviceTable.Value != TableId)
        {
            _stage = DisplayStage.WrongTable;
            _loaded = true;
            return;
        }

        _tableLabel = _deviceTableLabel ?? string.Empty;
        await LoadAsync();

        _loaded = true;

        StartLiveWorkIfNeeded();
    }

    protected override void OnAfterRender(bool firstRender)
        => StartLiveWorkIfNeeded();

    private void StartLiveWorkIfNeeded()
    {
        if (_liveWorkStarted || _disposed || !RendererInfo.IsInteractive)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (_stage is DisplayStage.NotPaired or DisplayStage.WrongTable)
        {
            return;
        }

        _liveWorkStarted = true;
        _subscription = Broadcaster.Subscribe(OnDomainNotification);
        _ = RunRefreshLoopAsync();
    }

    private async Task LoadAsync()
    {
        DisplayDeviceSession? session = await Devices.RevalidateAsync(_deviceIdentifier!.Value, _stopping);
        if (session is null)
        {
            _stage = DisplayStage.NotPaired;
            _qr = null;
            return;
        }

        _tableLabel = session.TableLabel;
        _deviceTableLabel = session.TableLabel;

        if (!session.TableIsActive)
        {
            _stage = DisplayStage.TableOutOfService;
            _qr = null;
            return;
        }

        _stage = DisplayStage.Live;
        _qr = await JoinTokens.DescribeCurrentAsync(TableId, _stopping);

        TableSittingSummary? sitting = await Sittings.GetOpenSittingAsync(TableId, _stopping);
        _partySize = sitting?.MemberCount ?? 0;
        _refreshSequence++;
    }

    private async Task RunRefreshLoopAsync()
    {
        while (!_stopping.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            try
            {
                await Task.Delay(DelayUntilNextWindow(), _stopping);
                await InvokeAsync(RefreshAsync);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
                return;
            }
            catch (ObjectDisposedException)
            {
                return;
            }
            catch (Exception exception)
            {
                Logger.LogWarning(
                    exception,
                    "Refreshing the display surface for table {TableIdentifier} failed; retrying at the next rotation boundary.",
                    TableId);
            }
        }
    }

    private async Task RefreshAsync()
    {
        await LoadAsync();

        if (_stage == DisplayStage.NotPaired)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(DisplayRoutes.Pair, forceLoad: true);
            return;
        }

        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private TimeSpan DelayUntilNextWindow()
        => DisplayRefreshSchedule.DelayUntilNextRefresh(
            Clock.UtcNow,
            _qr?.NextRotationAt,
            Options.TableJoinTokenRotationSeconds);

    private void OnDomainNotification(DomainNotification notification)
    {
        if (notification is not SittingMemberJoined && notification is not SittingClosed)
        {
            return;
        }

        _ = InvokeAsync(async () =>
        {
            try
            {
                TableSittingSummary? sitting = await Sittings.GetOpenSittingAsync(TableId, _stopping);
                _partySize = sitting?.MemberCount ?? 0;
                StateHasChanged();
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
            }
            catch (ObjectDisposedException)
            {
            }
        });
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (_disposed)
        {
            return;
        }

        _disposed = true;
        _subscription?.Dispose();
        _lifetime.Cancel();
        _lifetime.Dispose();
    }
}

@code {
    private static readonly TimeSpan RecentFulfillmentWindow = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15);

    private readonly KitchenAlertState _alerts = new();

    private readonly CancellationTokenSource _lifetime = new();
    private CancellationToken _stopping;
    private IDisposable? _subscription;
    private bool _disposed;

    private Guid? _person;
    private OrderActorRole _actorRole = OrderActorRole.Kitchen;
    private bool _loaded;
    private bool _busy;

    private IReadOnlyList<KitchenQueueTable> _queue = [];
    private IReadOnlyList<KitchenFulfilledLineView> _recentlyFulfilled = [];
    private IReadOnlyList<MenuItemSummary> _menu = [];

    private string? _actionNotice;
    private string? _actionProblem;
    private int _announcedAlertToken;

    [CascadingParameter]
    private Task<AuthenticationState>? AuthenticationStateTask { get; set; }

    private string IsLiveAttributeValue => RendererInfo.IsInteractive ? "true" : "false";

    private string IsLoadedAttributeValue => _loaded ? "true" : "false";

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        _stopping = _lifetime.Token;

        if (AuthenticationStateTask is not null)
        {
            AuthenticationState state = await AuthenticationStateTask;
            _person = PersonPrincipal.IdentifierFor(state.User);

            _actorRole = state.User.IsInRole(RestaurantRoles.Kitchen)
                ? OrderActorRole.Kitchen
                : OrderActorRole.Administrator;
        }

        await LoadAsync();
        _loaded = true;
    }

    protected override async Task OnAfterRenderAsync(bool firstRender)
    {
        if (firstRender)
        {
            _subscription = Broadcaster.Subscribe(OnDomainNotification);
        }

        if (_alerts.AlertToken == _announcedAlertToken)
        {
            return;
        }

        _announcedAlertToken = _alerts.AlertToken;

        if (!_alerts.IsArmed)
        {
            return;
        }

        bool played;
        try
        {
            played = await JavaScript.InvokeAsync<bool>(
                "myRestaurantKitchen.alert", _stopping, _alerts.LastAlertWasReminder);
        }
        catch (JSDisconnectedException)
        {
            return;
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            return;
        }
        catch (JSException)
        {
            played = false;
        }

        bool changed = played ? _alerts.ReportPlaybackSucceeded() : _alerts.ReportPlaybackFailed();
        if (changed)
        {
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    private async Task LoadAsync()
    {
        IReadOnlyList<KitchenPendingLineView> pending = await OrderReads
            .ListKitchenPendingLinesAsync(_stopping);

        _queue = KitchenQueue.Build(pending);

        _recentlyFulfilled = await KitchenReads
            .ListRecentlyFulfilledLinesAsync(Clock.UtcNow - RecentFulfillmentWindow, _stopping);

        _menu = await MenuDirectory.ListAsync(_stopping);
    }

    private Task FulfillLineAsync(KitchenQueueTicket ticket, KitchenQueueLine line)
        => AppendAsync(
            ticket.GuestOrderIdentifier,
            OrderEventType.Fulfillment,
            [new LineFulfilledOperation(line.OrderLineIdentifier)],
            $"{line.Quantity} × {line.MenuItemName} is away.");

    private Task FulfillTicketAsync(KitchenQueueTicket ticket)
        => AppendAsync(
            ticket.GuestOrderIdentifier,
            OrderEventType.Fulfillment,
            ticket.Lines.Select(line => (OrderOperation)new LineFulfilledOperation(line.OrderLineIdentifier)).ToArray(),
            $"{ticket.PersonName}'s order is away — {ticket.LineCount} {(ticket.LineCount == 1 ? "line" : "lines")}.");

    private Task UndoFulfillmentAsync(KitchenFulfilledLineView line)
        => AppendAsync(
            line.GuestOrderIdentifier,
            OrderEventType.FulfillmentReversal,
            [new LineFulfillmentRevertedOperation(line.OrderLineIdentifier)],
            $"{line.Quantity} × {line.MenuItemName} is back on the board.");

    private async Task AppendAsync(
        Guid guestOrderIdentifier,
        OrderEventType eventType,
        IReadOnlyList<OrderOperation> operations,
        string successMessage)
    {
        if (_person is not { } person || _busy || operations.Count == 0)
        {
            return;
        }

        _busy = true;
        _actionNotice = null;
        _actionProblem = null;

        try
        {
            AppendOrderEventResult result = await Workflow.AppendStaffEventAsync(
                guestOrderIdentifier,
                new ProposedOrderEvent(eventType, person, _actorRole, operations),
                _stopping);

            if (result.IsAppended)
            {
                _actionNotice = successMessage;

                _alerts.Acknowledge();
            }
            else
            {
                _actionProblem = DescribeRefusal(result);
            }

            await LoadAsync();
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
        }
        finally
        {
            _busy = false;
        }
    }

    private static string DescribeRefusal(AppendOrderEventResult result)
    {
        if (result.Outcome is AppendOrderEventOutcome.OrderNotFound or AppendOrderEventOutcome.SittingNotFound)
        {
            return "That table has been settled, so nothing more can be recorded against it.";
        }

        string reason = result.Errors.Count > 0
            ? result.Errors[0].Reason
            : "It was refused.";

        return $"Nothing was changed — {reason} The board has been refreshed.";
    }

    private static string HeadingId(MenuHeadingGroup heading)
        => $"kitchen-menu-section-{heading.MenuSectionIdentifier}";

    private async Task ToggleMenuItemAsync(MenuItemSummary item)
    {
        if (_person is not { } person || _busy)
        {
            return;
        }

        _busy = true;
        _actionNotice = null;
        _actionProblem = null;

        try
        {
            SetMenuItemAvailabilityResult result = await MenuWorkflow
                .SetMenuItemActiveAsync(item.MenuItemIdentifier, !item.IsActive, person, _stopping);

            _actionNotice = result.Outcome switch
            {
                SetMenuItemAvailabilityOutcome.Changed when result.IsActive => $"{result.Name} is back on.",
                SetMenuItemAvailabilityOutcome.Changed => $"{result.Name} is 86'd.",
                SetMenuItemAvailabilityOutcome.AlreadyInThatState => $"{result.Name} was already set that way.",
                _ => null,
            };

            if (!result.ItemExists)
            {
                _actionProblem = "That item is no longer on the menu.";
            }

            await LoadAsync();
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
        }
        finally
        {
            _busy = false;
        }
    }

    private async Task ArmSoundAsync()
    {
        bool armed;
        try
        {
            armed = await JavaScript.InvokeAsync<bool>("myRestaurantKitchen.arm", _stopping);
        }
        catch (JSDisconnectedException)
        {
            return;
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            return;
        }
        catch (JSException)
        {
            armed = false;
        }

        _alerts.Arm(armed);

        _announcedAlertToken = _alerts.AlertToken;
    }

    private void AcknowledgeAlerts()
    {
        _alerts.Acknowledge();
    }

    private void OnDomainNotification(DomainNotification notification)
    {
        bool concernsTheBoard = notification
            is OrderLinesChanged
            or LineFulfillmentChanged
            or SittingClosed
            or MenuChanged
            or KitchenAlert;

        if (!concernsTheBoard)
        {
            return;
        }

        KitchenAlertKind? alertKind = notification is KitchenAlert alert ? alert.Kind : null;

        _ = InvokeAsync(async () =>
        {
            if (_disposed)
            {
                return;
            }

            if (alertKind is { } kind)
            {
                _alerts.Record(kind);
            }

            try
            {
                await LoadAsync();
                StateHasChanged();
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
            }
            catch (ObjectDisposedException)
            {
            }
        });
    }

    private string Waiting(DateTimeOffset since)
    {
        TimeSpan elapsed = Clock.UtcNow - since;

        if (elapsed < TimeSpan.Zero)
        {
            elapsed = TimeSpan.Zero;
        }

        if (elapsed < TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1))
        {
            return "under a minute";
        }

        int minutes = (int)elapsed.TotalMinutes;
        if (minutes < 60)
        {
            return $"{minutes}m";
        }

        int hours = minutes / 60;
        return $"{hours}h {minutes % 60:D2}m";
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (_disposed)
        {
            return;
        }

        _disposed = true;
        _subscription?.Dispose();
        _lifetime.Cancel();
        _lifetime.Dispose();
    }
}

@code {
    private SetupTicketProtector _protector = default!;
    private SetupTicket? _ticket;
    private bool _adminExists;
    private bool _completed;
    private string? _completedUsername;
    private IReadOnlyList<string>? _recoveryCodes;
    private string? _errorMessage;

    private string _qrCodeSvg = string.Empty;
    private string _manualEntrySecret = string.Empty;

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "setup-account")]
    private AccountInputModel AccountInput { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "setup-passkey")]
    private PasskeyInputModel PasskeyInput { get; set; } = default!;

    [SupplyParameterFromForm(FormName = "setup-totp")]
    private TotpInputModel TotpInput { get; set; } = default!;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        AccountInput ??= new();
        PasskeyInput ??= new();
        TotpInput ??= new();
        _protector = new SetupTicketProtector(DataProtection);

        _adminExists = await Bootstrap.AdministratorExistsAsync(HttpContext.RequestAborted);
        if (_adminExists)
        {
            HttpContext.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status404NotFound;
            return;
        }

        if (HttpContext.Request.Cookies.TryGetValue(SetupCookie.Name, out string? cookie)
            && _protector.TryUnprotect(cookie, out SetupTicket? ticket)
            && ticket is not null
            && !ticket.HasExpired(Clock.UtcNow, SetupCookie.Lifetime))
        {
            _ticket = ticket;
            if (_ticket.Step == SetupStep.Totp && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(_ticket.TotpSecretBase32))
            {
                PrepareTotpDisplay(_ticket);
            }
        }
        else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(cookie))
        {
            SetupCookie.Delete(HttpContext.Response);
            _errorMessage = "Your setup session expired. Please start again.";
        }
    }

    private async Task StartAsync()
    {
        if (_adminExists)
        {
            return;
        }

        string username = AccountInput.Username.Trim();
        string? displayName = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(AccountInput.DisplayName)
            ? null
            : AccountInput.DisplayName.Trim();

        if (await UserManager.FindByNameAsync(username) is not null)
        {
            _errorMessage = "That username is already taken. Please choose another.";
            return;
        }

        Guid personIdentifier = IdentifierFactory.Create();

        string passwordHash = PasswordHasher.HashPassword(
            new Person { PersonIdentifier = personIdentifier, Username = username },
            AccountInput.Password);

        WriteTicketAndReload(new SetupTicket(
            personIdentifier,
            Clock.UtcNow,
            SetupStep.Passkey,
            username,
            displayName,
            passwordHash,
            Passkey: null,
            TotpSecretBase32: null));
    }

    private async Task RegisterPasskeyAsync()
    {
        if (_adminExists)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (_ticket is null || _ticket.Step != SetupStep.Passkey)
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(AccountRoutes.Setup);
            return;
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(PasskeyInput.Error))
        {
            _errorMessage = "That passkey could not be added. Please try again.";
            return;
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(PasskeyInput.CredentialJson))
        {
            _errorMessage = "Your browser did not provide a passkey.";
            return;
        }

        PasskeyAttestationResult attestation =
            await SignInManager.PerformPasskeyAttestationAsync(PasskeyInput.CredentialJson);
        if (!attestation.Succeeded || attestation.Passkey is null)
        {
            _errorMessage = "That passkey could not be registered. Please try again.";
            return;
        }

        UserPasskeyInfo info = attestation.Passkey;
        SetupPasskey passkey = new(
            info.CredentialId,
            info.PublicKey,
            (long)info.SignCount,
            info.Transports,
            Name: $"Passkey added {RestaurantClock.Date(Clock.UtcNow)}",
            info.IsUserVerified,
            info.IsBackupEligible,
            info.IsBackedUp);

        string totpSecretBase32 = Base32Text.Encode(Rfc6238Totp.GenerateSecret());

        WriteTicketAndReload(_ticket with
        {
            Step = SetupStep.Totp,
            Passkey = passkey,
            TotpSecretBase32 = totpSecretBase32,
        });
    }

    private Task ConfirmTotpAsync()
    {
        if (_adminExists)
        {
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }

        if (_ticket is null || _ticket.Step != SetupStep.Totp || string.IsNullOrEmpty(_ticket.TotpSecretBase32))
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(AccountRoutes.Setup);
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }

        if (!Base32Text.TryDecode(_ticket.TotpSecretBase32, out byte[] secret))
        {
            SetupCookie.Delete(HttpContext.Response);
            _ticket = null;
            _errorMessage = "Something went wrong with the setup code. Please start again.";
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }

        string normalized = (TotpInput.Code ?? string.Empty).Replace(" ", string.Empty).Replace("-", string.Empty);
        if (!Rfc6238Totp.ValidateCode(secret, normalized, Clock.UtcNow))
        {
            _errorMessage = "That code did not match. Check your authenticator and try again.";
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }

        WriteTicketAndReload(_ticket with { Step = SetupStep.Review });
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private async Task FinishAsync()
    {
        if (_adminExists)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (_ticket is null
            || _ticket.Step != SetupStep.Review
            || _ticket.Passkey is null
            || string.IsNullOrEmpty(_ticket.TotpSecretBase32))
        {
            Navigation.NavigateTo(AccountRoutes.Setup);
            return;
        }

        SetupPasskey stored = _ticket.Passkey;
        UserPasskeyInfo passkey = new(
            stored.CredentialId,
            stored.PublicKey,
            Clock.UtcNow,
            (uint)stored.SignatureCounter,
            stored.Transports,
            stored.IsUserVerified,
            stored.IsBackupEligible,
            stored.IsBackedUp,
            attestationObject: [],
            clientDataJson: [])
        {
            Name = stored.Name,
        };

        FirstAdministratorBootstrapResult result = await Bootstrap.CreateFirstAdministratorAsync(
            new NewAdministrator(
                _ticket.PersonIdentifier,
                _ticket.Username,
                _ticket.DisplayName,
                _ticket.PasswordHash,
                _ticket.TotpSecretBase32,
                passkey),
            HttpContext.RequestAborted);

        SetupCookie.Delete(HttpContext.Response);

        if (result.Status == FirstAdministratorBootstrapStatus.AdministratorAlreadyExists)
        {
            _adminExists = true;
            _ticket = null;
            HttpContext.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status404NotFound;
            return;
        }

        Person? administrator = await UserManager.FindByIdAsync(_ticket.PersonIdentifier.ToString());
        if (administrator is not null)
        {
            await SignInManager.SignInAsync(administrator, isPersistent: true);
        }

        _completedUsername = _ticket.Username;
        _recoveryCodes = result.RecoveryCodes;
        _completed = true;
        _ticket = null;
    }

    private void RestartAsync()
    {
        SetupCookie.Delete(HttpContext.Response);
        Navigation.NavigateTo(AccountRoutes.Setup);
    }

    private void WriteTicketAndReload(SetupTicket ticket)
    {
        SetupCookie.Write(HttpContext.Response, _protector.Protect(ticket));
        Navigation.NavigateTo(AccountRoutes.Setup);
    }

    private void PrepareTotpDisplay(SetupTicket ticket)
    {
        string provisioningUri = TotpProvisioningUri.Build(Options.RestaurantName, ticket.Username, ticket.TotpSecretBase32!);
        _qrCodeSvg = TotpQrCode.RenderSvg(provisioningUri);
        _manualEntrySecret = GroupForManualEntry(ticket.TotpSecretBase32!);
    }

    private int ActiveStepIndex => _ticket is null
        ? 0
        : _ticket.Step switch
        {
            SetupStep.Passkey => 1,
            SetupStep.Totp => 2,
            _ => 3,
        };

    private string StepClass(int index)
        => index == ActiveStepIndex ? "setup-step is-current"
            : index < ActiveStepIndex ? "setup-step is-done"
            : "setup-step";

    private static string GroupForManualEntry(string base32)
    {
        StringBuilder builder = new(base32.Length + (base32.Length / 4));
        for (int index = 0; index < base32.Length; index++)
        {
            if (index > 0 && index % 4 == 0)
            {
                builder.Append(' ');
            }

            builder.Append(base32[index]);
        }

        return builder.ToString();
    }

    private sealed class AccountInputModel
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Choose a username.")]
        [StringLength(64, MinimumLength = 3, ErrorMessage = "The username must be 3–64 characters.")]
        public string Username { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        [StringLength(120, ErrorMessage = "That display name is too long.")]
        public string? DisplayName { get; set; }

        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Choose a password.")]
        [StringLength(256, MinimumLength = 12, ErrorMessage = "Use at least 12 characters.")]
        public string Password { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Re-enter the password.")]
        [Compare(nameof(Password), ErrorMessage = "The passwords do not match.")]
        public string ConfirmPassword { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }

    private sealed class TotpInputModel
    {
        [Required(ErrorMessage = "Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.")]
        public string Code { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }
}
